    @classmethod
    def _dataset_to_tool_arguments(cls, item: dict, bundle: dict, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str) -> dict:
        """Adapt one verified canonical dataset to exactly one data branch of a tool schema."""
        parameters = _model_dump(item.get('parameters') or {})
        properties = parameters.get('properties') if isinstance(parameters.get('properties'), dict) else {}
        normalized_properties = {cls._normalized_tool_text(name).replace(' ', '_'): (name, _model_dump(raw_prop)) for name, raw_prop in properties.items()}
        required = {cls._normalized_tool_text(name).replace(' ', '_') for name in parameters.get('required') or []}
        args: dict[str, Any] = {}
        series = bundle.get('series') or []
        shared_x = bundle.get('shared_x')
        traces = [{'type': 'scatter', 'mode': str(entry.get('mode') or 'lines'), 'name': str(entry.get('name') or 'Řada'), 'x': entry.get('x') or shared_x, 'y': entry.get('y')} for entry in series]
        plotly_spec = {'data': traces, 'layout': {'title': bundle.get('title') or 'Pedagogická vizualizace', 'xaxis': {'title': bundle.get('x_label') or 'x'}, 'yaxis': {'title': bundle.get('y_label') or 'hodnota'}, 'showlegend': len(traces) > 1}}
        provider = str(item.get('provider') or 'generic')
        exact = cls._normalized_tool_text(item.get('declared_name') or item.get('function_name'))
        modes = {'series': {'series'}, 'plotly': {'traces', 'raw_plotly_data', 'plotly_data'}, 'specification': {'specification', 'spec', 'plotly_specification'}, 'dataset': {'dataset', 'field_data', 'point_data'}, 'data': {'data'}, 'xy': {'x', 'shared_x', 'x_values', 'x_data', 'y', 'y_values', 'y_data', 'values'}}
        mode = ''
        for candidate in ('series', 'plotly', 'specification', 'dataset', 'data', 'xy'):
            if required & modes[candidate]:
                mode = candidate
                break
        if not mode:
            preference = ('series', 'plotly', 'specification', 'dataset', 'data', 'xy')
            for candidate in preference:
                if set(normalized_properties) & modes[candidate]:
                    mode = candidate
                    break
        chosen_plotly_name = next((name for name in ('raw_plotly_data', 'plotly_data', 'traces') if name in normalized_properties and (name in required or not required & modes['plotly'])), '')
        chosen_spec_name = next((name for name in ('specification', 'plotly_specification', 'spec') if name in normalized_properties and (name in required or not required & modes['specification'])), '')
        chosen_dataset_name = next((name for name in ('dataset', 'field_data', 'point_data') if name in normalized_properties and (name in required or not required & modes['dataset'])), '')
        for normalized, (name, prop) in normalized_properties.items():
            expected = str(prop.get('type') or '')
            if normalized in set().union(*modes.values()):
                if mode == 'series':
                    if normalized == 'shared_x' and shared_x is not None:
                        args[name] = shared_x
                    elif normalized == 'series':
                        args[name] = [{'name': entry.get('name'), 'y': entry.get('y')} if shared_x is not None else {'name': entry.get('name'), 'x': entry.get('x'), 'y': entry.get('y')} for entry in series]
                    continue
                if mode == 'plotly':
                    if normalized == chosen_plotly_name:
                        args[name] = traces
                    continue
                if mode == 'specification':
                    if normalized == chosen_spec_name:
                        args[name] = json.dumps(plotly_spec, ensure_ascii=False) if expected == 'string' else plotly_spec
                    continue
                if mode == 'dataset':
                    if normalized == chosen_dataset_name:
                        point_rows = []
                        if series:
                            x_values = series[0].get('x') or shared_x or []
                            y_values = series[0].get('y') or []
                            point_rows = [{'x': x_value, 'value': y_value} for x_value, y_value in zip(x_values, y_values)]
                        payload = {'shared_x': shared_x, 'series': [{'name': entry.get('name'), 'x': entry.get('x'), 'y': entry.get('y')} for entry in series], 'points': point_rows, 'provenance': bundle.get('provenance')}
                        args[name] = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False) if expected == 'string' else payload
                    continue
                if mode == 'data':
                    if normalized == 'data':
                        if expected == 'array':
                            args[name] = traces
                        elif len(series) == 1:
                            args[name] = {'x': series[0].get('x') or shared_x, 'y': series[0].get('y'), 'name': series[0].get('name')}
                        else:
                            args[name] = {'shared_x': shared_x, 'series': [{'name': entry.get('name'), 'y': entry.get('y')} for entry in series]}
                    continue
                if mode == 'xy':
                    if normalized in {'x', 'shared_x', 'x_values', 'x_data'} and shared_x is not None:
                        args[name] = shared_x
                    elif normalized in {'y', 'y_values', 'y_data', 'values'} and len(series) == 1:
                        args[name] = series[0].get('y')
                    continue
            if normalized in {'field', 'field_name', 'scalar', 'variable'}:
                args[name] = str((series[0].get('name') if series else None) or 'value')
            elif normalized in {'title', 'caption', 'name'} and expected in {'', 'string'}:
                args[name] = bundle.get('title') or 'VUT AI Tutor – pedagogická vizualizace'
            elif normalized in {'x_label', 'xlabel', 'xaxis_title'}:
                args[name] = bundle.get('x_label') or 'x'
            elif normalized in {'y_label', 'ylabel', 'yaxis_title'}:
                args[name] = bundle.get('y_label') or 'hodnota'
            elif normalized in {'type', 'kind', 'chart_type', 'plot_type', 'visualization_type', 'visualisation_type'}:
                enum = prop.get('enum') if isinstance(prop.get('enum'), list) else []
                args[name] = next((entry for preferred in ('line', 'scatter', 'plot') for entry in enum if cls._normalized_tool_text(entry) == preferred), enum[0] if enum else 'line')
            elif normalized in {'prompt', 'description', 'instructions', 'request', 'task', 'text', 'input'}:
                args[name] = f'{user_text}\n\nPoužij pouze tento ověřený datový balík; nevymýšlej další hodnoty ani jednotky:\n' + json.dumps({'title': bundle.get('title'), 'x_label': bundle.get('x_label'), 'y_label': bundle.get('y_label'), 'shared_x': shared_x, 'series': series, 'assumptions': bundle.get('assumptions')}, ensure_ascii=False)[:50000]
            elif normalized in {'code', 'matlab_code', 'script'}:
                x_values = shared_x or (series[0].get('x') if series else [])
                y_values = series[0].get('y') if series else []
                if provider == 'matlab' or 'matlab' in exact:
                    xlabel = str(bundle.get('x_label') or 'x').replace("'", "''")
                    ylabel = str(bundle.get('y_label') or 'hodnota').replace("'", "''")
                    title = str(bundle.get('title') or 'Pedagogická vizualizace').replace("'", "''")
                    args[name] = 'x = [' + ' '.join((f'{float(value):.12g}' for value in x_values)) + '];\ny = [' + ' '.join((f'{float(value):.12g}' for value in y_values)) + f"];\nfigure('Color','w'); plot(x,y,'LineWidth',2); grid on;\nxlabel('{xlabel}'); ylabel('{ylabel}'); title('{title}');\n"
                else:
                    args[name] = f"import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nx = {json.dumps(x_values)}\ny = {json.dumps(y_values)}\nplt.figure(); plt.plot(x, y); plt.grid(True)\nplt.xlabel({json.dumps(bundle.get('x_label') or 'x')})\nplt.ylabel({json.dumps(bundle.get('y_label') or 'hodnota')})\nplt.title({json.dumps(bundle.get('title') or 'Pedagogická vizualizace')})\nplt.show()\n"
            elif normalized in {'max_figures', 'figure_count'} and expected == 'integer':
                args[name] = min(2, int(prop.get('maximum') or 2))
            elif normalized in {'resolution', 'dpi'} and expected == 'integer':
                args[name] = min(150, int(prop.get('maximum') or 150))
            elif 'default' in prop:
                args[name] = prop['default']
        return cls._validated_tool_arguments(args, parameters)

    @classmethod
    def _select_data_producer(cls, strategy: str, inventory: list[dict], excluded: set[tuple[str, str]] | None=None, preferred_provider: str='') -> dict | None:
        excluded = excluded or set()
        candidates: list[tuple[float, dict]] = []
        for item in inventory or []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict) or not item.get('invocable'):
                continue
            key = (cls._normalized_tool_text(item.get('function_name') or item.get('declared_name')), str(item.get('tool_id') or ''))
            if key in excluded:
                continue
            profile = cls._tool_output_profile(item)
            capability = str(item.get('capability') or '')
            exact = cls._normalized_tool_text(item.get('declared_name') or item.get('function_name'))
            provider = str(item.get('provider') or 'generic')
            preferred = cls._normalized_tool_text(preferred_provider).replace('_', ' ').strip()
            identity_text = cls._normalized_tool_text(' '.join((str(item.get(key) or '') for key in ('provider', 'installed_name', 'tool_id', 'function_name', 'declared_name', 'description')))).replace('_', ' ')
            if preferred and preferred not in identity_text:
                continue
            score = 100.0 if preferred else 0.0
            if strategy == 'solve':
                if not profile.get('can_compute'):
                    continue
                score += 25.0
                if capability in {'numerical', 'symbolic', 'simulation', 'code'}:
                    score += 15.0
                if provider in {'matlab', 'python', 'sympy', 'ansys', 'comsol', 'openfoam'}:
                    score += 5.0
                if exact in {'execute_code', 'evaluate_matlab_code'}:
                    score += 10.0
                if exact == 'evaluate_matlab_code_with_figures':
                    score -= 8.0
            elif strategy == 'internet':
                if not (profile.get('can_fetch') or capability == 'research'):
                    continue
                score += 30.0
                if any((token in exact for token in ('fetch_url', 'download', 'search_web', 'browse', 'get_dataset'))):
                    score += 15.0
            else:
                continue
            if item.get('active_in_chat'):
                score += 4.0
            score += float(item.get('confidence') or 0) * 3.0
            candidates.append((score, item))
        if not candidates:
            return None
        candidates.sort(key=lambda row: (-row[0], str(row[1].get('installed_name') or '')))
        return candidates[0][1]

    async def _plan_data_acquisition_arguments(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, item: dict, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, strategy: str) -> dict:
        parameters = _model_dump(item.get('parameters') or {})
        properties = parameters.get('properties') if isinstance(parameters.get('properties'), dict) else {}
        args: dict[str, Any] = {}
        url_match = re.search('https?://[^\\s)\\]>\'\\"]+', user_text)
        for name, raw_prop in properties.items():
            prop = _model_dump(raw_prop)
            normalized = self._normalized_tool_text(name).replace(' ', '_')
            if normalized in {'url', 'uri', 'link'} and url_match:
                args[name] = url_match.group(0)
            elif normalized in {'query', 'search_query', 'q', 'prompt', 'request', 'task', 'text', 'input'} and strategy == 'internet':
                args[name] = user_text[:20000]
            elif 'default' in prop:
                args[name] = prop['default']
        if not self._schema_argument_issues(args, parameters):
            return args
        if strategy == 'solve':
            known = self._known_tool_plan(item, user_text, dynamic_context, choose_defaults=True, data_only=True)
            if known is not None and (not self._validate_tool_plan(item, known, user_text)):
                return known.get('arguments') or {}
        worker_request = user_text + '\n\nINTERNAL DATA-PREPARATION MODE: produce machine-readable numeric data. For executable code return a compact machine-readable result. Never print image/base64 data. Python may print VUT_AI_DATA_JSON=<JSON> with at most 128 sampled x values per series. MATLAB must not print full numeric arrays; print only VUT_AI_METRICS_JSON=<small JSON> and let the deterministic kernel retain x/y data. Do not create a graph in this phase and do not explain the result.'
        plan = await self._native_tool_worker_plan(request, user, base_model, item, worker_request, dynamic_context)
        if not plan:
            plan = await self._json_tool_worker_plan(request, user, base_model, item, worker_request, dynamic_context)
        if plan.get('needs_user_input'):
            return {'needs_user_input': str(plan.get('needs_user_input'))[:1200]}
        arguments = self._validated_tool_arguments(plan.get('arguments') or {}, parameters)
        for key, value in list(arguments.items()):
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                continue
            normalized = self._normalized_tool_text(key).replace(' ', '_')
            if normalized in {'code', 'matlab_code', 'python_code', 'script', 'source_code', 'apdl_code'} or normalized.endswith('_code'):
                arguments[key] = self._sanitize_tool_code(value, self._tool_code_language(item, normalized))
        issues = self._schema_argument_issues(arguments, parameters)
        if issues:
            return {'needs_user_input': 'Pro získání dat chybí: ' + '; '.join(issues[:6])}
        return arguments

    async def _invoke_data_producer(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, producer: dict, available_tools: dict, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, strategy: str, body: dict, metadata: dict, files: list, event_emitter=None, event_call=None) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
        function_name = str(producer.get('function_name') or producer.get('declared_name') or '')
        tool_id = str(producer.get('tool_id') or '')
        registry = self._coalesce_tool_registry(available_tools)
        resolved_name, entry = self._lookup_tool_entry(registry, function_name, tool_id)
        if entry:
            resolved_name, entry = self._preferred_execution_variant(str(resolved_name or function_name), entry)
        if entry and isinstance(entry.get('deferred'), dict) and (not callable(entry.get('callable'))):
            resolved_name, entry = await self._materialize_deferred_tool(request, user, str(resolved_name or function_name), entry, body=body, metadata=metadata, files=files, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call)
        if not entry or not (callable(entry.get('callable')) or entry.get('direct')):
            return (None, f"Datový nástroj {producer.get('installed_name') or function_name} není právě volatelný.")
        arguments = await self._plan_data_acquisition_arguments(request, user, base_model, producer, user_text, dynamic_context, strategy)
        if arguments.get('needs_user_input'):
            return (None, str(arguments['needs_user_input']))
        plan = {'arguments': arguments, 'assumptions': [], 'output_intent': 'illustrative' if self._problem_spec(user_text, dynamic_context).get('allow_illustrative') else 'source-derived'}
        max_attempts = 2 if self._tool_retry_allowed(producer, entry) else 1
        last_error = ''
        result: Any = None
        for attempt in range(max_attempts):
            try:
                result = await self._invoke_tool_entry(entry, str(resolved_name or function_name), plan.get('arguments') or {}, body=body, metadata=metadata, files=files, event_call=event_call)
                last_error = self._runtime_error_text(result)
                if not last_error:
                    break
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = self._compact_runtime_error(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
                log.info('VUT AI Tutor data producer attempt %s failed: %s', attempt + 1, last_error)
            if self._legacy_engineering_mcp_capture_error(last_error):
                last_error = self._friendly_tool_runtime_error(last_error)
                break
            if attempt + 1 >= max_attempts:
                break
            if plan.get('planner') == 'deterministic-adapter' and (not self._is_transient_tool_error(last_error)):
                break
            previous_arguments = plan.get('arguments') or {}
            previous_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(previous_arguments, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
            repaired = await self._repair_runtime_plan(request, user, base_model, producer, user_text, dynamic_context, plan, last_error)
            if self._validate_tool_plan(producer, repaired, user_text):
                break
            repaired_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(repaired.get('arguments') or {}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
            if repaired_fingerprint == previous_fingerprint and (not self._is_transient_tool_error(last_error)):
                break
            plan = repaired
        if last_error:
            last_error = self._friendly_tool_runtime_error(last_error)
        bundle = self._extract_dataset_bundle(result) if not last_error else None
        if bundle:
            bundle['provenance'] = f"tool:{tool_id or producer.get('installed_name')}/{function_name}"
            return (bundle, '')
        known_reference = self._normalized_illustrative_dataset(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if not last_error and known_reference and (self._canonical_operation_name(function_name) in {'evaluate_matlab_code', 'evaluate_matlab_code_with_figures'}):
            metrics = self._extract_matlab_metrics(result)
            known_reference['provenance'] = 'deterministic-kernel:matlab-execution-confirmed:' + self._canonical_operation_name(function_name)
            if metrics:
                summary = ', '.join((f'{key}={value}' for key, value in list(metrics.items())[:10]))
                known_reference.setdefault('verification', []).append('MATLAB compact metrics receipt: ' + summary)
            else:
                known_reference.setdefault('verification', []).append('MATLAB dokončil volání bez plného datového přenosu; kanonická data poskytl ověřený lokální adaptér.')
            return (known_reference, '')
        fallback = self._normalized_illustrative_dataset(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if strategy == 'solve' and fallback:
            fallback['provenance'] = 'deterministic-kernel-fallback-after-tool-error:' + self._canonical_operation_name(function_name)
            fallback.setdefault('verification', []).append('Externí výpočetní nástroj nedodal ověřitelnou datovou sadu; byla použita lokální deterministická šablona.')
            if last_error:
                fallback.setdefault('verification', []).append('Diagnostika externího nástroje: ' + last_error[:500])
            return (fallback, '')
        if last_error:
            return (None, f'Získání dat selhalo v {function_name}: {last_error[:800]}')
        return (None, f'Funkce **{function_name}** byla spuštěna, ale nevrátila strojově čitelná data x/y nebo series. Uveďte přesnější zdroj nebo povolte normalizovaný ilustrační příklad.')

    async def _acquire_workflow_dataset(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, strategy: str, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, available_tools: dict, body: dict, metadata: dict, files: list, event_emitter=None, event_call=None, excluded: set[tuple[str, str]] | None=None, preferred_provider: str='') -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
        provided = self._extract_dataset_bundle(user_text)
        if provided:
            provided['provenance'] = 'provided-by-user'
            return (provided, '')
        if strategy == 'normalized-illustrative':
            bundle = self._normalized_illustrative_dataset(user_text, dynamic_context)
            if bundle:
                return (bundle, '')
            return (None, 'Zdroj nestačí pro bezpečný normalizovaný příklad. Doplňte veličinu a závislost, nebo zvolte dopočet konkrétní rovnice.')
        if strategy == 'random':
            return (self._deterministic_random_dataset(user_text), '')
        if strategy == 'internet' and (not re.search('https?://|\\b(dataset|databaze|tabulka|csv)\\s+[A-Za-z0-9]', user_text, re.I)):
            return (None, 'Pro stažení dat uveďte konkrétní URL nebo jednoznačný název datasetu a požadované sloupce.')
        problem = self._problem_spec(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if strategy == 'solve' and problem.get('kind') not in {'', 'unclassified', None} and (not preferred_provider):
            bundle = self._normalized_illustrative_dataset(user_text, dynamic_context)
            if bundle:
                bundle['provenance'] = 'deterministic-kernel:verified-problem-adapter'
                return (bundle, '')
        inventory = self._full_tool_inventory(available_tools)
        producer = self._select_data_producer(strategy, inventory, excluded, preferred_provider=preferred_provider)
        if producer:
            bundle, error = await self._invoke_data_producer(request, user, base_model, producer, available_tools, user_text, dynamic_context, strategy, body, metadata, files, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call)
            if bundle:
                return (bundle, '')
            if preferred_provider:
                return (None, error or f'Výslovně požadovaný producent {preferred_provider} nevrátil použitelná data.')
            if strategy != 'solve':
                return (None, error)
        elif preferred_provider:
            return (None, f'V aktuálním workspace není dostupná volatelná funkce požadovaného producentu **{preferred_provider}**. Zapněte ji v chatu nebo obnovte katalog nástrojů.')
        if strategy == 'solve':
            fallback = self._normalized_illustrative_dataset(user_text, dynamic_context)
            if fallback:
                fallback['provenance'] = 'deterministic-kernel:no-external-producer'
                fallback.setdefault('verification', []).append('Data vytvořilo lokální ověřené jádro VUT AI Tutoru, protože nebyl dostupný použitelný výpočetní producent.')
                return (fallback, '')
        label = 'výpočetní' if strategy == 'solve' else 'vyhledávací/stahovací'
        return (None, f'V aktuálním workspace není dostupný vhodný {label} nástroj pro získání dat. Zapněte například MATLAB/Python/SymPy nebo webový fetch nástroj, případně zvolte normalizovaný příklad.')

    async def _execute_tool_workflow(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, marker: dict, available_tools: dict | None, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, body: dict, selection: dict | None, event_emitter=None, event_call=None, metadata: dict | None=None, files: list | None=None, thread_id: str='') -> Any:
        metadata = dict(metadata or body.get('metadata') or {})
        registry = self._coalesce_tool_registry(available_tools)
        inventory = self._full_tool_inventory(registry)
        actions = [dict(item) for item in marker.get('actions') or [] if isinstance(item, dict)]
        if not actions:
            function_name = str(marker.get('function') or '')
            tool_id = str(marker.get('tool_id') or '')
            match = next((item for item in inventory if self._normalized_tool_text(item.get('function_name') or item.get('declared_name')) == self._normalized_tool_text(function_name) and self._tool_ids_equivalent(str(item.get('tool_id') or ''), tool_id)), None)
            if match:
                actions = [{'function': function_name, 'tool_id': tool_id, 'capability': str(marker.get('capability') or match.get('capability') or 'generic'), 'registry_key': str(match.get('registry_key') or ''), 'installed_name': str(match.get('installed_name') or ''), 'provider': str(match.get('provider') or 'generic'), 'output_profile': self._tool_output_profile(match)}]
            else:
                return await self._execute_tool_action(request, user, base_model, marker, registry, user_text, dynamic_context, body, selection, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call, metadata=metadata, files=files, thread_id=thread_id)
        deduped: list[dict] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for action in actions:
            key = (self._normalized_tool_text(action.get('function') or ''), str(action.get('registry_key') or action.get('tool_id') or ''))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(action)
        actions = deduped[:4]
        dataset = self._extract_dataset_bundle(marker.get('model_preplanned_arguments'))
        needs_dataset = self._workflow_needs_dataset(actions)
        marker_strategy = str(marker.get('data_strategy') or _model_dump(marker.get('output_requirements') or {}).get('data_strategy') or 'unspecified')
        strategy = marker_strategy if marker_strategy != 'unspecified' else self._infer_tool_data_strategy(user_text, dynamic_context)
        problem = self._problem_spec(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if needs_dataset and (not dataset) and (strategy == 'unspecified') and (problem.get('kind') not in {'', 'unclassified', None}):
            strategy = 'solve' if re.search('experiment|stabilit|spocit|vypocit|vyres', self._normalized_tool_text(user_text)) else 'normalized-illustrative'
        preferred_provider = str(marker.get('preferred_provider') or '').strip().casefold()
        if not preferred_provider:
            mentioned = list(_model_dump(marker.get('output_requirements') or {}).get('mentioned_providers') or [])
            if len(mentioned) == 1:
                preferred_provider = str(mentioned[0]).strip().casefold()
        if needs_dataset and (not dataset):
            if strategy == 'unspecified':
                question = self._data_strategy_question()
                chat_id = str(metadata.get('chat_id') or body.get('chat_id') or '')
                payload = dict(marker)
                payload['workflow_stage'] = 'data_strategy'
                saved = await self.db.save_tool_action_thread(user.id, chat_id, str(marker.get('session_id') or ''), payload, user_text, question, thread_id=thread_id)
                resume = self._workflow_resume_marker(saved, 'data_strategy')
                return question + f'\n\n*Workflow je uložen ({saved[:8]}). Odpovězte jednou z možností nebo napište „zrušit“.*\n\n{resume}'
            excluded = {(self._normalized_tool_text(action.get('function') or ''), str(action.get('tool_id') or '')) for action in actions}
            dataset, error = await self._acquire_workflow_dataset(request, user, base_model, strategy, user_text, dynamic_context, registry, body, metadata, files or [], event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call, excluded=excluded, preferred_provider=preferred_provider)
            if not dataset:
                chat_id = str(metadata.get('chat_id') or body.get('chat_id') or '')
                payload = dict(marker)
                payload.update({'data_strategy': strategy, 'preferred_provider': preferred_provider, 'workflow_stage': 'data_acquisition'})
                saved = await self.db.save_tool_action_thread(user.id, chat_id, str(marker.get('session_id') or ''), payload, user_text, error, thread_id=thread_id)
                resume = self._workflow_resume_marker(saved, 'data_acquisition')
                return error + f'\n\n*Workflow je uložen ({saved[:8]}); po doplnění dat bude pokračovat bez nové volby rendereru.*\n\n{resume}'
        results: list[tuple[dict, str, bool]] = []
        for index, action in enumerate(actions, start=1):
            function_name = str(action.get('function') or '')
            tool_id = str(action.get('tool_id') or '')
            resolved_name, entry = self._lookup_tool_entry(registry, function_name, tool_id)
            catalog_item = None
            if entry:
                catalog = self._safe_tool_catalog({str(resolved_name or function_name): entry})
                catalog_item = catalog[0] if catalog else self._generic_tool_catalog_item(str(resolved_name or function_name), entry, str(action.get('capability') or 'generic'))
            preplanned = None
            if dataset is not None and catalog_item is not None:
                args = self._dataset_to_tool_arguments(catalog_item, dataset, user_text, dynamic_context)
                issues = self._schema_argument_issues(args, _model_dump(catalog_item.get('parameters') or {}))
                if issues:
                    results.append((action, 'Nástroj nebyl spuštěn: datový balík nelze převést do jeho schématu: ' + '; '.join(issues[:6]), False))
                    continue
                preplanned = args
            if event_emitter:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'status', 'data': {'description': f"Spouštím {index}/{len(actions)}: {action.get('installed_name') or function_name}…", 'done': False}})
            response = await self._execute_tool_action(request=request, user=user, base_model=base_model, marker={**action, 'session_id': marker.get('session_id'), 'file_id': marker.get('file_id'), 'page': marker.get('page')}, available_tools=registry, user_text=user_text, dynamic_context=dynamic_context, body=body, selection=selection, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call, metadata=metadata, files=files or [], thread_id='', preplanned_arguments=preplanned)
            text = str(response)
            failed = bool(re.search('nebyl spuštěn|nepodařilo|neprošel|selhalo|nevrátil|nepřipojilo', text, re.I))
            results.append((action, text, not failed))
        await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed' if any((ok for _, _, ok in results)) else 'failed')
        if not results:
            return 'Žádný pedagogicky vhodný nástroj nebylo možné spustit.'
        sections: list[str] = []
        successful = [row for row in results if row[2]]
        if len(successful) > 1:
            sections.append(f'Byly použity **{len(successful)} vzájemně se doplňující nástroje**, protože po porovnání očekávaných výstupů nebyl žádný z nich redundantní.')
        elif successful:
            reasons = successful[0][0].get('selection_reasons') or []
            sections.append('Byl vybrán nejvhodnější výstup' + (': ' + '; '.join(reasons[:3]) if reasons else '.'))
        if dataset:
            data_text = '**Použitá data:** ' + str(dataset.get('provenance') or 'ověřený datový balík')
            if dataset.get('assumptions'):
                data_text += '\n\nPracovní předpoklady:\n- ' + '\n- '.join(dataset.get('assumptions') or [])
            if dataset.get('verification'):
                data_text += '\n\nKontroly:\n- ' + '\n- '.join(dataset.get('verification') or [])
            sections.append(data_text)
        for action, response, _ in results:
            sections.append(f"### {action.get('installed_name') or action.get('function') or 'Nástroj'}\n\n{response}")
        return '\n\n'.join(sections)

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_clarification_text(cls, user_text: str) -> str:
        value = str(user_text or '')
        matches = re.findall('(?:Předchozí|Aktuální) doplnění uživatele:\\s*(.*?)(?=(?:Předchozí|Aktuální) doplnění uživatele:|WORKFLOW_|$)', value, flags=re.I | re.S)
        if matches:
            return '\n'.join((part.strip() for part in matches if part.strip()))
        return value

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_delegated_input_fields(cls, clarification: str, product: str='mechanical') -> set[str]:
        """Return engineering input groups the user explicitly delegated to the Tutor.

        The UI examples and the backend use this single deterministic parser.  Broad
        consent delegates every still-missing engineering input, while a narrow phrase
        such as ``zvol tranzientní typ analýzy`` delegates only that one category.
        """
        folded = cls._normalized_tool_text(clarification).replace('_', ' ').strip()
        if not folded:
            return set()
        if re.search('\\b(?:nechci|nepreji|nepovol|nedovol|nezvol|nevybir|nedopln|nenastav|nevytvar|bez doplneni|bez domnenek|ptej se na vse|nejprve se zeptej)\\b', folded):
            return set()
        all_fields = {'analysis_type', 'geometry', 'material', 'boundaries', 'load', 'time_mesh', 'outputs'}
        exact_all = {'dopln vse vhodne', 'dopln vsechny potrebne udaje', 'pouzij jednoduchy ilustracni model', 'pouzij normalizovany ilustracni model', 'zvol reprezentativni hodnoty podle rovnice', 'zvol reprezentativni parametry podle rovnice', 'zvol reprezentativni udaje podle rovnice', 'zvol vhodne hodnoty podle rovnice', 'zvol vhodne parametry podle rovnice', 'zvol a nastav vse vhodne', 'nastav vse vhodne', 'zvol vhodne sam', 'vyber vhodne sam'}
        if folded in exact_all:
            return set(all_fields)
        tokens = set(folded.split())
        has_delegate_verb = bool(tokens & {'dopln', 'zvol', 'vyber', 'nastav', 'navrhni', 'urci', 'pouzij', 'vytvor', 'priprav'})
        has_scope = bool(tokens & {'vse', 'vsechno', 'vsechny', 'potrebne', 'ostatni'})
        has_input_noun = bool(tokens & {'udaje', 'vstupy', 'parametry', 'hodnoty', 'nastaveni'})
        has_general_qualifier = bool(tokens & {'reprezentativni', 'ilustracni', 'normalizovany', 'normalizovane', 'idealizovany', 'idealizovane', 'vychozi', 'defaultni', 'vhodne'})
        source_bound = bool(re.search('\\bpodle (?:rovnice|textu|pasaze|zdroje)\\b', folded))
        illustrative_model = bool(re.search('\\b(?:pouzij|vytvor|priprav)\\b', folded) and re.search('\\b(?:jednoduchy|normalizovany|ilustracni|idealizovany|technicky)\\b', folded) and re.search('\\b(?:model|priklad)\\b', folded))
        if has_delegate_verb and has_scope and has_input_noun:
            return set(all_fields)
        if has_delegate_verb and has_general_qualifier and has_input_noun and source_bound:
            return set(all_fields)
        if illustrative_model:
            return set(all_fields)
        fields: set[str] = set()
        if not has_delegate_verb:
            return fields
        category_patterns = {'analysis_type': '\\b(?:typ analyzy|analyzu|statick[a-z0-9]*|tranzient[a-z0-9]*|transient[a-z0-9]*|dynamick[a-z0-9]*|modal[a-z0-9]*|harmonick[a-z0-9]*|tepeln[a-z0-9]*)\\b', 'geometry': '\\b(?:geometri[a-z0-9]*|rozmer[a-z0-9]*|tvar[a-z0-9]*|modelov[a-z0-9]* oblast)\\b', 'material': '\\b(?:material[a-z0-9]*|young[a-z0-9]*|poisson[a-z0-9]*|hustot[a-z0-9]*|medium|tekutin[a-z0-9]*)\\b', 'boundaries': '\\b(?:okrajov[a-z0-9]*|ulozen[a-z0-9]*|podpor[a-z0-9]*|vazb[a-z0-9]*|inlet|outlet|sten[a-z0-9]*)\\b', 'load': '\\b(?:zatizen[a-z0-9]*|sil[a-z0-9]*|trak[a-z0-9]*|tlak[a-z0-9]*|zdroj[a-z0-9]*|pocatecn[a-z0-9]* podm[a-z0-9]*|casov[a-z0-9]* prubeh)\\b', 'time_mesh': '\\b(?:mesh|sit|element[a-z0-9]*|casov[a-z0-9]* krok|time step|doba reseni|celkov[a-z0-9]* cas)\\b', 'outputs': '\\b(?:vysled[a-z0-9]*|vystup[a-z0-9]*|konverg[a-z0-9]*|zobrazovan[a-z0-9]* velicin[a-z0-9]*)\\b'}
        for field, pattern in category_patterns.items():
            if re.search(pattern, folded):
                fields.add(field)
        return fields

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_defaults_allowed(cls, clarification: str, product: str='mechanical') -> bool:
        required = {'analysis_type', 'geometry', 'material', 'boundaries', 'load', 'outputs'}
        return required.issubset(cls._ansys_delegated_input_fields(clarification, product=product))

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_mechanical_illustrative_spec(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """Return a checked domain adapter only when the source identifies that model.

        There is deliberately no generic static-structural fallback.  A book about knitting,
        history, language, or any other non-solver topic must not be converted into a beam or
        bar merely because Mechanical is installed.
        """
        spec = cls._problem_spec(text, '')
        if str(spec.get('kind') or '') != 'wave-1d-fixed-left-prescribed-traction-right':
            return ''
        return 'SOURCE_BOUND_DOMAIN_ADAPTER (normalised illustration; not book data):\n- Learning object: the one-dimensional second-order-in-time bar equation recognised in the source.\n- Analysis family: transient structural dynamics of a slender homogeneous bar.\n- Geometry: rectangular bar, length 1.0 m, cross-section 0.01 m x 0.01 m.\n- Material: illustrative structural steel, E=210 GPa, nu=0.30, density=7850 kg/m^3.\n- Initial state: zero displacement and zero velocity.\n- Boundary conditions: left end fixed; right end receives an axial half-sine force pulse.\n- Load: peak 1000 N, duration 0.0004 s; afterwards zero traction.\n- Time integration: total time 0.002 s, requested maximum step 1e-5 s.\n- Mesh: quadratic solid elements with a mesh-quality check.\n- Requested results: axial displacement, normal stress/strain, support reaction, energy, and time histories.\n- Source check: map the fixed face to u(0,t)=0 and the end force to E*u_x(L,t)=tau(t).\n'

    def _ansys_analysis_input_gaps(cls, clarification: str, product: str='mechanical', delegated_fields: set[str] | None=None) -> list[str]:
        folded = cls._normalized_tool_text(clarification).replace('_', ' ')

        if product == 'fluent':
            checks = [('analysis_type', 'typ proudění a režim řešení (ustálené/tranzientní, stlačitelné/nestlačitelné a případný model turbulence)', '\\b(steady|ustalen[a-z0-9]*|transient|tranzient[a-z0-9]*|compress[a-z0-9]*|stlacit[a-z0-9]*|incompress[a-z0-9]*|nestlacit[a-z0-9]*|laminar|turbulen[a-z0-9]*|k epsilon|k omega|les|rans)\\b'), ('geometry', 'geometrii, síť nebo case/mesh soubor včetně rozměrů', '\\b(geometry|geometri[a-z0-9]*|mesh|sit[a-z0-9]*|case|cas|msh|soubor[a-z0-9]*|delk[a-z0-9]*|sirk[a-z0-9]*|vysk[a-z0-9]*|prumer[a-z0-9]*|rozmer[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('material', 'médium, jeho vlastnosti a jednotkový systém', '\\b(fluid|tekutin[a-z0-9]*|vzduch|air|voda|water|density|hustot[a-z0-9]*|viscos[a-z0-9]*|viskozit[a-z0-9]*|kg|pas|pa s|si|jednot[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('boundaries', 'okrajové podmínky na pojmenovaných plochách (vstup, výstup, stěny, symetrie)', '\\b(boundary|okrajov[a-z0-9]*|inlet|vstup[a-z0-9]*|outlet|vystup[a-z0-9]*|wall|sten[a-z0-9]*|symmetr[a-z0-9]*|velocity|rychlost|pressure|tlak[a-z0-9]*|mass flow|prutok[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('load', 'počáteční podmínky, zdroje a případné tepelné nebo objemové zatížení', '\\b(initial|pocatecn[a-z0-9]*|initialize|source|zdroj[a-z0-9]*|heat|tepl[a-z0-9]*|energy|gravity|gravit[a-z0-9]*|rotat[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('outputs', 'konvergenční kritéria, počet iterací/časový krok a požadované výsledky', '\\b(converg[a-z0-9]*|residual|rezidu[a-z0-9]*|iteration|iterac[a-z0-9]*|time step|casov[a-z0-9]*|krok[a-z0-9]*|velocity|pressure|temperature|teplot[a-z0-9]*|force|drag|lift|prutok[a-z0-9]*|vysled[a-z0-9]*)\\b')]
            return [label for field, label, pattern in checks if field not in delegated and (not re.search(pattern, folded))]
        checks = [('analysis_type', 'typ analýzy (např. statická, tranzientní, modální nebo harmonická)', '\\b(statick[a-z0-9]*|tranzient[a-z0-9]*|transient[a-z0-9]*|dynamick[a-z0-9]*|modal[a-z0-9]*|harmonick[a-z0-9]*|thermal[a-z0-9]*|teplotn[a-z0-9]*|buckling|vzper[a-z0-9]*|vlnov[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('geometry', 'geometrii nebo soubor geometrie včetně rozměrů', '\\b(geometry|geometri[a-z0-9]*|step|stp|iges|igs|parasolid|x t|soubor[a-z0-9]*|delk[a-z0-9]*|sirk[a-z0-9]*|vysk[a-z0-9]*|tloust[a-z0-9]*|prumer[a-z0-9]*|polomer[a-z0-9]*|rozmer[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('material', 'materiálové údaje a jednotky (alespoň E, ν a podle typu úlohy ρ)', '\\b(material[a-z0-9]*|young[a-z0-9]*|modul[a-z0-9]*|poisson[a-z0-9]*|hustot[a-z0-9]*|rho|ocel|steel|hlinik|aluminium|mpa|gpa|pa)\\b'), ('boundaries', 'okrajové podmínky / uložení s určením příslušných ploch nebo hran', '\\b(okrajov[a-z0-9]*|boundary|fixed|support|ulozen[a-z0-9]*|vetknut[a-z0-9]*|dirichlet|neumann|symmetr[a-z0-9]*|constraint|uchyc[a-z0-9]*)\\b'), ('load', 'zatížení včetně velikosti, směru, časového průběhu a jednotek', '\\b(zatizen[a-z0-9]*|load[a-z0-9]*|force|sila|tlak[a-z0-9]*|pressure|trak[a-z0-9]*|moment|torque|teplot[a-z0-9]*|acceleration|gravit[a-z0-9]*|tau|newton|n|kn|mpa|pa)\\b'), ('outputs', 'požadovaný výsledek a základní nastavení sítě/času', '\\b(vysled[a-z0-9]*|stress|napeti|deform[a-z0-9]*|displacement|posun[a-z0-9]*|strain|reakc[a-z0-9]*|frekvenc[a-z0-9]*|mesh|sit[a-z0-9]*|element[a-z0-9]*|time step|casov[a-z0-9]*|krok[a-z0-9]*)\\b')]
        return [label for field, label, pattern in checks if field not in delegated and (not re.search(pattern, folded))]

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_model_confirmed(cls, text: str) -> bool:
        folded = cls._normalized_tool_text(text).replace('_', ' ')

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_mechanical_source_form(cls, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str) -> dict:
        """Build a deterministic audit form from source facts before asking for numbers."""
        spec = cls._problem_spec(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if str(spec.get('kind') or '') != 'wave-1d-fixed-left-prescribed-traction-right':
            return {}
        prepared = '\n'.join((
            'SOURCE_BOUND_MECHANICAL_MODEL:',
            '- Analysis mapping: transient structural dynamics (working inference from the second time derivative; the source itself does not name an ANSYS analysis system).',
            '- Source geometry: one-dimensional bar domain x in (0,l). Numerical length, cross-section and Mechanical representation are not specified.',
            '- Source material symbols: Young-type modulus E and density rho. Numerical values and units are not specified.',
            '- Source equation: rho*u_tt - d/dx(E*u_x) = f.',
            '- Source boundary condition at x=0: u(0,t)=0.',
            '- Source boundary condition at x=l: E*u_x(l,t)=tau_hat(t).',
            '- Source initial conditions: u(x,t0)=U0(x) and u_t(x,t0)=U1(x).',
            '- Source primary result: displacement field u(x,t).',
            '- No numerical dimensions, unit system, material values, load histories, initial functions, mesh, time step, end time or additional result requests are supplied by the passage.',
        ))
        form = '\n'.join((
            '### ANSYS Mechanical · auditovatelný modelový formulář',
            '',
            'Analýza zatím **nebyla spuštěna**. Formulář níže odděluje údaje knihy, pracovní mapování do Mechanical a skutečně chybějící solverové vstupy.',
            '',

    @classmethod
    def _ansys_mechanical_source_gaps(cls, clarification: str, delegated_fields: set[str], *, confirmed: bool) -> list[str]:
        folded = cls._normalized_tool_text(clarification).replace('_', ' ')
        delegated = set(delegated_fields or ())
        gaps: list[str] = []
        length_ok = bool(re.search('(?:\\bl\\b|delk[a-z0-9]*|length)\\s*(?:[:=]\\s*)?[0-9]', folded))
        section_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:prurez[a-z0-9]*|cross section|section|prumer[a-z0-9]*|diameter|tloust[a-z0-9]*|sirk[a-z0-9]*|vysk[a-z0-9]*)\\b', folded))
        representation_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:line body|beam|truss|1d|jednorozmern[a-z0-9]*|3d|solid|objemov[a-z0-9]*)\\b', folded))
        if 'geometry' not in delegated and not (length_ok and section_ok and representation_ok):
            gaps.append('Geometrie: číselná délka `l`, průřez a reprezentace v Mechanical (line body / 3D solid).')
        modulus_ok = bool(re.search('(?:\\be\\b|young[a-z0-9]*|modul[a-z0-9]*)\\s*(?:[:=]\\s*)?[0-9]', folded))
        density_ok = bool(re.search('(?:\\brho\\b|\\bρ\\b|hustot[a-z0-9]*|density)\\s*(?:[:=]\\s*)?[0-9]', folded))
        units_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:si|mks|nmm|mm|cm|m|pa|mpa|gpa|kg|s)\\b', folded))
        if 'material' not in delegated and not (modulus_ok and density_ok and units_ok):
            gaps.append('Materiál a jednotky: jednotkový systém, `E`, `ρ` a případně `ν` pouze pro 3D solid.')
        load_signals = (
            bool(re.search('(?:\\bf\\b(?:\\s+[a-z]){0,4}\\s+[+-]?[0-9]|objemov[a-z0-9]* sil[a-z0-9]*|body force)', folded)),
            bool(re.search('(?:tau|trak[a-z0-9]*|force pulse|silov[a-z0-9]* prubeh|zatizen[a-z0-9]*)', folded)),
            bool(re.search('(?:\\bu0\\b\\s+[+-]?[0-9]|\\bu\\s+0\\s+[+-]?[0-9]|pocatecn[a-z0-9]* posun)', folded)),
            bool(re.search('(?:\\bu1\\b\\s+[+-]?[0-9]|\\bu\\s+1\\s+[+-]?[0-9]|pocatecn[a-z0-9]* rychlost)', folded)),
        )
        if 'load' not in delegated and not all(load_signals):
            gaps.append('Zatížení a počáteční podmínky: konkrétní `f(x,t)`, `\\hat{τ}(t)`, `U_0(x)`, `U_1(x)` včetně jednotek.')
        time_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:koncov[a-z0-9]* cas|celkov[a-z0-9]* cas|end time|total time|t_end|tmax)\\b', folded)) and bool(re.search('\\b(?:casov[a-z0-9]* krok|time step|substep[a-z0-9]*|dt)\\b', folded))
        mesh_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:mesh|sit|element[a-z0-9]*|prvek|velikost prvk[a-z0-9]*|element size)\\b', folded))
        if 'time_mesh' not in delegated and not (time_ok and mesh_ok):
            gaps.append('Síť a čas: typ/velikost prvků, kontrola sítě, koncový čas a časový krok/substepping.')
        outputs_ok = bool(re.search('\\b(?:vysled[a-z0-9]*|posun[a-z0-9]*|displacement|napeti|stress|deform[a-z0-9]*|strain|reakc[a-z0-9]*|energy|energie|sond[a-z0-9]*|export)\\b', folded))
        if 'outputs' not in delegated and not outputs_ok:
            gaps.append('Výsledky: přesný seznam požadovaných výsledků, sond a exportů.')
        if not confirmed:
            gaps.append('Potvrzení: schválit tranzientní mapování a vazbu obou okrajových podmínek na model Mechanical (např. „potvrzuji model“).')
        return gaps

    @classmethod
    def _mechanical_guideline_arguments(cls, entry: dict, content: str) -> dict | None:
        spec = _model_dump((entry or {}).get('spec') or {})
        parameters = _model_dump(spec.get('parameters') or spec.get('inputSchema') or {})
        properties = parameters.get('properties') if isinstance(parameters.get('properties'), dict) else {}
        for name in ('content', 'topic'):
            if name in properties:
                return {name: content}
        required = parameters.get('required') if isinstance(parameters.get('required'), list) else []
        string_names = [str(name) for name, raw in properties.items() if str(_model_dump(raw).get('type') or 'string') == 'string']
        if len(required) == 1 and str(required[0]) in string_names:
            return {str(required[0]): content}
        if len(string_names) == 1:
            return {string_names[0]: content}
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _tool_response_failed(value: Any) -> bool:
        text = str(value or '')
        return bool(re.search('nebyl spuštěn|nepodařilo|selhal|není dostup|neni dostup|neprošel|chyba nástroje|tool .* failed|error:', text, flags=re.I))

    @classmethod
    def _mechanical_status_connected(cls, value: Any) -> bool:
        text = cls._normalized_tool_text(str(value or '')).replace('_', ' ')
        if re.search('\\b(no mechanical connection|not connected|disconnected|connection false|connected false|bez pripojeni)\\b', text):
            return False
        return bool(re.search('\\b(connected true|status connected|mechanical session connected|active connection|connection is alive true|is alive true|already connected|session ready|pripojen[a-z0-9]*|relace aktivn[a-z0-9]*)\\b', text))

    async def _execute_ansys_product_workflow(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, marker: dict, available_tools: dict | None, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, body: dict, selection: dict | None, event_emitter=None, event_call=None, metadata: dict | None=None, files: list | None=None, thread_id: str='') -> Any:
        metadata = dict(metadata or body.get('metadata') or {})
        chat_id = str(metadata.get('chat_id') or body.get('chat_id') or '')
        workflow_kind = str(marker.get('workflow_kind') or 'ansys-ansys-analysis')
        product = str(marker.get('ansys_product') or '')
        if not product:
            match = re.match('ansys-([a-z0-9_-]+)-analysis', workflow_kind)
            product = match.group(1) if match else 'ansys'
        continuation = bool(marker.get('workflow_continuation'))
        clarification = self._ansys_clarification_text(user_text) if continuation else ''
        registry = self._coalesce_tool_registry(available_tools)
        available_products = sorted({candidate[2] for candidate in self._ansys_registry_candidates(registry) if candidate[2]})
        fit_text = (clarification or str(user_text or '')) + '\n' + str(dynamic_context or '')[-12000:]
        generated_canvas_scenario = '### Studijní scénář' in str(user_text or '') or '### Závazně zvolený nástroj' in str(user_text or '')
        explicit_source = clarification if continuation else '' if generated_canvas_scenario else str(user_text or '')
        explicit_current = bool(re.search(f'\\b(?:pouzij|spust|chci|pozaduji|trvam na|vyber)\\b.{{0,60}}\\b{re.escape(product)}\\b|\\b{re.escape(product)}\\b.{{0,30}}\\b(?:pouzij|spust|workflow)\\b', self._normalized_tool_text(explicit_source).replace('_', ' '))) if product not in {'ansys', ''} else False
        ranked_products = sorted(((self._ansys_product_fit(candidate, fit_text)[0], candidate) for candidate in available_products), reverse=True)
        best_product = ranked_products[0][1] if ranked_products else product
        current_score = self._ansys_product_fit(product, fit_text)[0]
        best_score = ranked_products[0][0] if ranked_products else current_score
        if not explicit_current and best_product and (best_product != product) and (best_score >= current_score + 22.0):
            previous_name = self._ansys_product_label(product)[0]
            product = best_product
            workflow_kind = f'ansys-{product}-analysis'
            marker = {**marker, 'ansys_product': product, 'workflow_kind': workflow_kind, 'function': f"__vut_{workflow_kind.replace('-', '_')}_workflow__", 'preferred_function': '', 'preferred_operation': ''}
            if product == 'mechanical':
                note = f'Původně zvolený {previous_name} neodpovídá fyzice upřesněné úlohy; workflow bylo přesměrováno na ANSYS Mechanical.\n\n'
                result = await self._execute_ansys_mechanical_workflow(request, user, base_model, marker, registry, user_text, dynamic_context, body, selection, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call, metadata=metadata, files=files or [], thread_id=thread_id)
                return note + str(result)
        product_name = self._ansys_product_label(product)[0]
        if product not in available_products and product != 'ansys':
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            return f'Produkt **{product_name}** už není v živém katalogu dostupný. Dostupné ANSYS produkty: ' + (', '.join((self._ansys_product_label(value)[0] for value in available_products)) or 'žádné') + '. Jiný produkt nebyl použit bez souhlasu.'
        delegated_fields = {str(value) for value in marker.get('delegated_input_fields') or [] if str(value)}
        delegated_fields.update(self._ansys_delegated_input_fields(clarification, product=product))
        required_fields = {'analysis_type', 'geometry', 'material', 'boundaries', 'load', 'outputs'}
        defaults_allowed = bool(marker.get('illustrative_defaults')) or required_fields.issubset(delegated_fields)
        if defaults_allowed:
            delegated_fields.update(required_fields)
            marker = {**marker, 'illustrative_defaults': True, 'delegated_input_fields': sorted(delegated_fields)}
        gaps = self._ansys_analysis_input_gaps(clarification, product=product, delegated_fields=delegated_fields) if continuation and (not defaults_allowed) else ['typ proudění a režim řešení', 'geometrii, síť nebo case/mesh soubor', 'médium, vlastnosti a jednotky', 'okrajové podmínky na pojmenovaných plochách', 'počáteční podmínky a zdroje', 'konvergenci, iterace/časový krok a požadované výsledky'] if product in {'fluent', 'cfx'} else ['typ analýzy', 'geometrii nebo vstupní model', 'materiál a jednotky', 'okrajové podmínky', 'zatížení nebo zdroje', 'požadované výsledky a kontrolu konvergence']
        if gaps:
            question = f'### {product_name} · chybějící vstupy\n\nSolver zatím **nebyl spuštěn**. Doplňte:\n\n- ' + '\n- '.join(gaps) + '\n\nMůžete výslovně požádat o normalizovaný ilustrační model; všechny doplněné hodnoty budou označeny jako ilustrativní.'
            payload = {**marker, 'workflow_kind': workflow_kind, 'workflow_stage': 'collect_inputs', 'strict_exact': True, 'provider': 'ansys', 'ansys_product': product, 'illustrative_defaults': defaults_allowed, 'delegated_input_fields': sorted(delegated_fields)}
            saved = await self.db.save_tool_action_thread(user.id, chat_id, str(marker.get('session_id') or ''), payload, str(user_text or ''), question, thread_id=thread_id, ttl_seconds=3600)
            return question + f'\n\n*Workflow {product_name} je uložen ({saved[:8]}). Odpovězte údaji nebo napište ‚zrušit‘.*\n\n' + self._workflow_resume_marker(saved, f'ansys_{product}_inputs')
        candidates = self._ansys_registry_candidates(registry, product)
        requested_origin = set((str(value) for value in marker.get('origin_aliases') or [] if str(value)))
        requested_origin.add(str(marker.get('origin_key') or ''))
        requested_origin.discard('')
        candidate_functions = [str(value) for value in marker.get('candidate_functions') or [] if str(value)]
        candidate_operations = [str(value) for value in marker.get('candidate_operations') or [] if str(value)]
        preferred = str(marker.get('preferred_function') or '')
        preferred_operation = str(marker.get('preferred_operation') or '')
        ranked: list[tuple[float, str, dict, str]] = []
        for name, entry, found_product, operation in candidates:
            origin = self._tool_entry_origin_details(name, entry)
            aliases = set(origin.get('origin_aliases') or []) | {str(origin.get('origin_key') or '')}
            aliases.discard('')
            score = self._ansys_operation_score(product, operation, bool(_model_dump(entry.get('metadata') or {}).get('vut_ai_active_in_chat')))
            if requested_origin and requested_origin & aliases:
                score += 45.0
            if preferred and self._canonical_operation_name(preferred) == operation:
                score += 24.0
            if preferred_operation and preferred_operation == operation:
                score += 28.0
            if name in candidate_functions or operation in candidate_operations:
                score += 16.0
            ranked.append((score, name, entry, operation))
        ranked.sort(key=lambda value: (-value[0], value[1]))
        if not ranked:
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            return f'V živém katalogu není dostupná spustitelná operace produktu {product_name}. Jiný ANSYS produkt ani SciViz nebyl použit.'
        _score, run_name, run_entry, run_operation = ranked[0]
        technical_spec = f'ANSYS_PRODUCT={product_name}\nANSYS_INPUT_SPEC_BEGIN\n' + (clarification or str(user_text or ''))[:24000] + '\nANSYS_INPUT_SPEC_END\n\nUse only the exact selected ANSYS product. Keep units and assumptions explicit. Do not import numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib or any module. Use only objects exposed by the ANSYS sandbox. Configure, solve and return compact convergence and result data. Do not substitute SciViz or local Python.'
        origin = self._tool_entry_origin_details(run_name, run_entry)
        response = await self._execute_tool_action(request=request, user=user, base_model=base_model, marker={'function': str(run_name), 'tool_id': str(run_entry.get('tool_id') or ''), 'capability': 'simulation', 'provider': 'ansys', 'ansys_product': product, 'preferred_operation': run_operation, 'origin_key': origin.get('origin_key'), 'origin_url': origin.get('origin_url'), 'origin_aliases': origin.get('origin_aliases'), 'strict_exact': True, 'session_id': marker.get('session_id'), 'file_id': marker.get('file_id'), 'page': marker.get('page')}, available_tools=registry, user_text=technical_spec, dynamic_context=dynamic_context, body=body, selection=selection, event_emitter=event_emitter, event_call=event_call, metadata=metadata, files=files or [], thread_id='')
        if self._tool_response_failed(response):
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            return f'### {product_name} · solver selhal\n\n' + str(response)
        await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
        return f'## {product_name} workflow dokončen\n\nByl použit provider **{product_name}**, nikoli jiný ANSYS produkt ani SciViz.\n\n' + str(response)

    async def _compile_source_bound_simulation_spec(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, *, allow_illustrative_defaults: bool, product: str='mechanical') -> dict:
        """Compile a tool-independent simulation brief; never emit solver code here."""
        learning = self._learning_affordance_profile(user_text, dynamic_context)
        if float(learning.get('solver_readiness') or 0.0) < 0.48:
            return {'relevant': False, 'reason': 'Vybraná pasáž neobsahuje dostatečně určený fyzikální nebo inženýrský model. Simulace by byla od tématu odtržená a studentovi by nepomohla.', 'learning_object': learning}
        compact = self._compact_tool_context(user_text, dynamic_context)
        system = 'You are a source-bound pedagogical simulation-spec compiler. You do not write solver code and do not call tools. Return one JSON object only. Determine whether the requested solver can illuminate the selected source. If it cannot, set relevant=false. If illustrative defaults are allowed, choose the smallest representative model consistent with the source and mark every chosen value as an assumption. Never replace the source topic with a familiar beam, bar, heat-transfer, or CFD example merely because that solver supports it.'
        schema_instruction = {'relevant': 'boolean', 'reason': 'string', 'subject': 'string', 'learning_question': 'string', 'analysis_family': 'string', 'geometry': ['string'], 'materials_or_entities': ['string'], 'governing_relations': ['string'], 'boundary_or_context_conditions': ['string'], 'loads_inputs_or_actions': ['string'], 'discretization_or_resolution': ['string'], 'requested_outputs': ['string'], 'source_supported_facts': ['string'], 'illustrative_assumptions': ['string'], 'missing_information': ['string'], 'pedagogical_value': 'string'}
        user_message = f'TARGET_PRODUCT: ANSYS {product}\nILLUSTRATIVE_DEFAULTS_ALLOWED: {str(bool(allow_illustrative_defaults)).lower()}\nLEARNING_OBJECT_PROFILE: {json.dumps(learning, ensure_ascii=False)}\nREQUIRED_JSON_SHAPE: {json.dumps(schema_instruction, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\nREQUEST_AND_SOURCE:\n{compact[:30000]}'
        payload = {'model': base_model, 'stream': False, 'temperature': 0.0, 'response_format': {'type': 'json_object'}, 'messages': [{'role': 'system', 'content': system}, {'role': 'user', 'content': user_message}], 'metadata': {'user_id': user.id, 'study_tutor_internal': True, 'tool_ids': [], 'files': []}}
        try:
            response = await self._generate_completion(request, payload, user)
        except Exception:
            payload.pop('response_format', None)
            try:
                response = await self._generate_completion(request, payload, user)
            except Exception:
                return {'relevant': False, 'reason': 'Sémantickou specifikaci simulace se nepodařilo bezpečně sestavit.'}
        parsed = _clean_json_block(self._completion_text(response)) or {}
        if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
            return {'relevant': False, 'reason': 'Model nevrátil validní specifikaci simulace.'}
        parsed['relevant'] = bool(parsed.get('relevant'))
        parsed['learning_object'] = learning
        for key in ('geometry', 'materials_or_entities', 'governing_relations', 'boundary_or_context_conditions', 'loads_inputs_or_actions', 'discretization_or_resolution', 'requested_outputs', 'source_supported_facts', 'illustrative_assumptions', 'missing_information'):
            value = parsed.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                value = [value]
            parsed[key] = [str(item).strip() for item in value or [] if str(item).strip()][:16]
        if parsed.get('missing_information') and allow_illustrative_defaults:
            if not parsed.get('illustrative_assumptions'):
                parsed['relevant'] = False
                parsed['reason'] = 'Chybějící vstupy nebyly nahrazeny transparentními ilustračními předpoklady.'
        return parsed

    @staticmethod
    def _simulation_spec_text(spec: dict) -> str:
        if not isinstance(spec, dict):
            return ''
        headings = (('subject', 'Subject'), ('learning_question', 'Learning question'), ('analysis_family', 'Analysis family'), ('geometry', 'Geometry / representation'), ('materials_or_entities', 'Materials / entities'), ('governing_relations', 'Governing relations'), ('boundary_or_context_conditions', 'Boundary / context conditions'), ('loads_inputs_or_actions', 'Loads / inputs / actions'), ('discretization_or_resolution', 'Discretization / resolution'), ('requested_outputs', 'Requested outputs'), ('source_supported_facts', 'Source-supported facts'), ('illustrative_assumptions', 'Illustrative assumptions'), ('pedagogical_value', 'Pedagogical value'))
        lines = ['SOURCE_BOUND_SIMULATION_SPEC:']
        for key, label in headings:
            value = spec.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                if value:
                    lines.append(f'- {label}:')
                    lines.extend((f'  - {item}' for item in value))
            elif str(value or '').strip():
                lines.append(f'- {label}: {str(value).strip()}')
        return '\n'.join(lines)

    async def _execute_ansys_mechanical_workflow(self, request: Request, user, base_model: str, marker: dict, available_tools: dict | None, user_text: str, dynamic_context: str, body: dict, selection: dict | None, event_emitter=None, event_call=None, metadata: dict | None=None, files: list | None=None, thread_id: str='') -> Any:
        """Run a provider-locked Mechanical transaction without relying on dynamic routes."""
        metadata = dict(metadata or body.get('metadata') or {})
        chat_id = str(metadata.get('chat_id') or body.get('chat_id') or '')
        stage = str(marker.get('workflow_stage') or 'collect_inputs')
        continuation = bool(marker.get('workflow_continuation'))
        clarification = self._ansys_clarification_text(user_text) if continuation else ''
        source_form = self._ansys_mechanical_source_form(str(marker.get('prepared_spec') or user_text or ''), dynamic_context)
        source_fields = {str(value) for value in marker.get('source_provided_fields') or [] if str(value)}
        source_fields.update((source_form.get('source_provided_fields') or []))
        delegated_fields = {str(value) for value in marker.get('delegated_input_fields') or [] if str(value)}
        delegated_fields.update(self._ansys_delegated_input_fields(clarification, product='mechanical'))
        required_fields = {'analysis_type', 'geometry', 'material', 'boundaries', 'load', 'time_mesh', 'outputs'}
        defaults_allowed = bool(marker.get('illustrative_defaults')) or (required_fields - source_fields).issubset(delegated_fields)
        if defaults_allowed:
            delegated_fields.update(required_fields - source_fields)
        model_confirmed = bool(marker.get('model_confirmed')) or self._ansys_model_confirmed(clarification)
