            plan = await self._repair_tool_plan(request, user, base_model, item, user_text, dynamic_context, plan, validation_errors)
            validation_errors = self._validate_tool_plan(item, plan, user_text)
        if validation_errors:
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            return 'Nástroj nebyl spuštěn, protože plán neprošel kontrolou:\n\n- ' + '\n- '.join(validation_errors)
        arguments = plan.get('arguments') or {}
        metadata = dict(metadata or body.get('metadata') or {})
        tool_type = str(entry.get('type') or '')
        protocol = str(_model_dump(entry.get('metadata') or {}).get('vut_ai_protocol') or '')
        if protocol == 'mcp':
            tool_type = 'mcp'
        direct_tool = bool(entry.get('direct'))
        entry_spec = _model_dump(entry.get('spec') or {})
        execution_name = str(entry_spec.get('name') or resolved_name) if direct_tool else str(resolved_name)
        max_attempts = 2 if self._tool_retry_allowed(item, entry) else 1
        result: Any = None
        runtime_error = ''
        for attempt in range(max_attempts):
            try:
                result = await self._invoke_tool_entry(entry, str(resolved_name or function_name), arguments, body=body, metadata=metadata, files=files or [], event_call=event_call)
                runtime_error = self._runtime_error_text(result)
                if not runtime_error:
                    break
            except Exception as exc:
                runtime_error = self._compact_runtime_error(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
                log.info('VUT AI Tutor tool attempt %s/%s failed: %s', attempt + 1, max_attempts, runtime_error)
            if self._legacy_engineering_mcp_capture_error(runtime_error):
                runtime_error = self._friendly_tool_runtime_error(runtime_error)
                break
            if attempt + 1 >= max_attempts:
                break
            if plan.get('planner') == 'deterministic-adapter' and (not self._is_transient_tool_error(runtime_error)):
                break
            previous_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(arguments, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
            if event_emitter:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'status', 'data': {'description': f"{item['display_name']}: opravuji vstup po chybě nástroje (pokus {attempt + 2}/{max_attempts})…", 'done': False}})
            repaired_plan = await self._repair_runtime_plan(request, user, base_model, item, user_text, dynamic_context, plan, runtime_error)
            validation_errors = self._validate_tool_plan(item, repaired_plan, user_text)
            if validation_errors:
                runtime_error += '; opravený plán neprošel kontrolou: ' + '; '.join(validation_errors[:6])
                break
            repaired_arguments = repaired_plan.get('arguments') or {}
            repaired_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(repaired_arguments, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
            if repaired_fingerprint == previous_fingerprint and (not self._is_transient_tool_error(runtime_error)):
                break
            plan = repaired_plan
            arguments = repaired_arguments
        if runtime_error:
            runtime_error = self._friendly_tool_runtime_error(runtime_error)
            fallback = None if strict_exact else await self._emit_verified_local_kernel_fallback(user_text=user_text, dynamic_context=dynamic_context, failed_tool=str(item.get('display_name') or execution_name), reason=runtime_error, event_emitter=event_emitter)
            if fallback:
                await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
                return fallback
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            return f"Nástroj **{item['display_name']}** nevytvořil použitelný výsledek.\n\nDiagnostika: `{self._compact_runtime_error(runtime_error, 1200)}`"
        raw_image_files = self._raw_image_files(result, str(item.get('action_label') or item.get('display_name') or 'Výstup nástroje'))
        official_result = result
        official_files: list[dict] = []
        official_embeds: list[str] = []
        try:
            from open_webui.utils.middleware import terminal_event_handler
            official_result, official_files, official_embeds = await self._process_tool_result_compat(request, execution_name, result, tool_type, direct_tool, metadata, user)
            if event_emitter is not None:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    terminal_value = terminal_event_handler(execution_name, arguments, official_result, event_emitter)
                    if inspect.isawaitable(terminal_value):
                        await terminal_value
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug('VUT AI Tutor native result processing unavailable: %s', exc)
            official_result = result
            official_files = []
            official_embeds = []
        presentation = self._tool_result_payload(result, capability=str(item.get('capability') or ''), arguments=arguments, title=str(item.get('action_label') or item.get('display_name') or 'Výstup nástroje'))
        normalized_presentation = self._tool_result_payload(official_result, capability=str(item.get('capability') or ''), arguments=arguments, title=str(item.get('action_label') or item.get('display_name') or 'Výstup nástroje'))
        result_text = str(presentation.get('text') or normalized_presentation.get('text') or official_result or result or '')[:40000]
        result_validation_errors: list[str] = []
        capability = str(item.get('capability') or '')
        visual_capabilities = {'plot', 'image', 'diagram', 'model3d', 'field_visualization'}
        internal_nonvisual_roles = {'lifecycle', 'connection', 'model_setup', 'setup', 'solver_setup', 'solver'}
        if expected_artifact == 'visual':
            visual_required = True
        elif expected_artifact in {'none', 'optional'} or execution_role in internal_nonvisual_roles:
            visual_required = False
        else:
            visual_required = capability in visual_capabilities or self._visual_artifact_requested(user_text, capability)
        result_series = self._extract_chart_series(result) or self._extract_chart_series(official_result) or self._extract_chart_series(arguments)
        if capability == 'plot' and result_series:
            result_validation_errors = self._validate_tool_plan({'capability': 'plot'}, {'arguments': {'series': result_series, 'title': str(arguments.get('title') or arguments.get('layout') or '')}, 'assumptions': plan.get('assumptions') or [], 'output_intent': plan.get('output_intent') or 'source-derived'}, user_text)
        preliminary_artifacts = bool(raw_image_files or presentation.get('embeds') or presentation.get('files') or normalized_presentation.get('embeds') or normalized_presentation.get('files') or official_embeds or official_files or result_series)
        if visual_required and (not preliminary_artifacts):
            result_validation_errors.append('Vizuální funkce nevrátila žádný obraz, HTML/SVG, soubor ani číselnou řadu. Textový stav nebo průběhová hláška není vizualizace.')
        if visual_required and re.search('(?:^|\\n)\\s*Querying\\s*(?:$|\\n)|\\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:[^{}]+\\}', result_text):
            result_validation_errors.append('Nástroj vrátil nedokončenou průběhovou nebo šablonovou hlášku místo artefaktu.')
        if re.search('(?:Traceback \\(most recent call last\\)|SyntaxError|TypeError|IndexError|NameError|ValueError):', result_text, re.I):
            result_validation_errors.append('Výpočetní nástroj vrátil běhovou chybu místo výsledku.')
        if result_validation_errors:
            fallback = None if strict_exact else await self._emit_verified_local_kernel_fallback(user_text=user_text, dynamic_context=dynamic_context, failed_tool=str(item.get('display_name') or execution_name), reason='; '.join(result_validation_errors), event_emitter=event_emitter)
            if fallback:
                await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
                return fallback
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            if event_emitter:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'notification', 'data': {'type': 'error', 'content': 'Výsledek nástroje neprošel matematickou nebo technickou kontrolou: ' + '; '.join(result_validation_errors)}})
            return f"Nástroj **{item['display_name']}** byl spuštěn, ale jeho výsledek nebyl zobrazen, protože neprošel kontrolou:\n\n- " + '\n- '.join(result_validation_errors)
        embeds: list[str] = []
        embed_seen: set[str] = set()
        for embed in [*(official_embeds or []), *(presentation.get('embeds') or []), *(normalized_presentation.get('embeds') or [])]:
            if not isinstance(embed, str) or not embed.strip():
                continue
            key = hashlib.sha256(embed.encode('utf-8', errors='replace')).hexdigest()
            if key in embed_seen:
                continue
            embed_seen.add(key)
            embeds.append(embed)
            if len(embeds) >= 4:
                break
        output_files: list[dict] = []
        file_seen: set[str] = set()
        for file_item in [*raw_image_files, *(official_files or []), *(presentation.get('files') or []), *(normalized_presentation.get('files') or [])]:
            if not isinstance(file_item, dict):
                continue
            try:
                key = json.dumps(file_item, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str)
            except Exception:
                key = repr(file_item)
            if key in file_seen:
                continue
            file_seen.add(key)
            output_files.append(file_item)
            if len(output_files) >= 20:
                break
        receipt = {'status': 'executed', 'tool_id': str(entry.get('tool_id') or tool_id), 'function_name': execution_name, 'provider': str(item.get('provider') or 'generic'), 'execution_mode': 'direct-client' if direct_tool else 'backend-callable', 'result_type': type(result).__name__, 'visual_required': visual_required, 'execution_role': execution_role, 'expected_artifact': expected_artifact, 'embed_count': len(embeds), 'file_count': len(output_files), 'artifact_count': len(embeds) + len(output_files), 'artifact_delivery': 'pending'}
        delivery_errors: list[str] = []
        emitted_embeds = 0
        emitted_files = 0
        if event_emitter:
            if output_files:
                try:
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'files', 'data': {'files': output_files}})
                    emitted_files = len(output_files)
                except Exception as exc:
                    delivery_errors.append(f'files: {type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:240]}')
            if embeds:
                try:
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'embeds', 'data': {'embeds': embeds, 'replace': False}})
                    emitted_embeds = len(embeds)
                except Exception as exc:
                    delivery_errors.append(f'embeds: {type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:240]}')
        elif embeds or output_files:
            delivery_errors.append('Open WebUI neposkytlo event emitter pro aktuální zprávu.')
        delivered_count = emitted_embeds + emitted_files
        receipt.update({'emitted_embed_count': emitted_embeds, 'emitted_file_count': emitted_files, 'artifact_delivery': 'emitted' if delivered_count else 'not-required' if not (embeds or output_files) else 'failed', 'delivery_errors': delivery_errors})
        if visual_required and delivered_count == 0:
            fallback = None if strict_exact else await self._emit_verified_local_kernel_fallback(user_text=user_text, dynamic_context=dynamic_context, failed_tool=str(item.get('display_name') or execution_name), reason='Externí funkce nevytvořila nebo nedoručila vizuální artefakt. ' + '; '.join(delivery_errors), event_emitter=event_emitter)
            if fallback:
                await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
                return fallback
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'failed')
            message = f'Funkce **{execution_name}** byla vykonána a vrátila vizuální data, ale Open WebUI je nepřipojilo k aktuální zprávě. Tutor proto netvrdí, že je graf zobrazen.'
            if delivery_errors:
                message += '\n\nTechnická diagnostika:\n- ' + '\n- '.join(delivery_errors)
            return message
        if execution_role in {'lifecycle', 'connection', 'model_setup', 'setup', 'solver_setup'}:
            await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
            if event_emitter:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await event_emitter({'type': 'status', 'data': {'description': f"{item['display_name']}: interní krok workflow dokončen.", 'done': True}})
            compact_text = self._compact_runtime_error(result_text).strip()
            role_label = {'lifecycle': 'Stavový krok', 'connection': 'Připojení', 'model_setup': 'Příprava modelu', 'setup': 'Příprava', 'solver_setup': 'Příprava solveru'}.get(execution_role, 'Interní krok')
            return f"**{role_label}:** {item['display_name']} (`{execution_name}`) · dokončeno" + (f'\n\n```text\n{compact_text[:12000]}\n```' if compact_text else '\n\nOperace byla dokončena bez samostatného textového výstupu.')
        answer = await self._interpret_tool_result(request, user, base_model, user_text=user_text, item=item, execution_name=execution_name, arguments=arguments, plan=plan, result_text=result_text, receipt=receipt, dynamic_context=dynamic_context)
        await self.db.finish_tool_action_thread(user.id, thread_id, 'completed')
        if event_emitter:
            with suppress(Exception):
                description = f"{item['display_name']}: připojeno {delivered_count} vizuálních nebo souborových výstupů." if delivered_count else f"{item['display_name']}: výpočet dokončen bez samostatného artefaktu."
                await event_emitter({'type': 'status', 'data': {'description': description, 'done': True}})
        receipt_line = f"**Nástroj:** {item['display_name']} (`{execution_name}`) · " + (f'připojené výstupy: {delivered_count}' if delivered_count else 'textový výsledek')
        if answer:
            return receipt_line + '\n\n' + answer
        if delivered_count:
            return receipt_line + '\n\nArtefakt byl připojen přímo k této asistentské zprávě.'
        return receipt_line + f'\n\n```text\n{result_text[:12000]}\n```'

    @staticmethod
    def _knowledge_field(value: Any, name: str, default: Any=None) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return value.get(name, default)
        return getattr(value, name, default)

    @staticmethod
    def _knowledge_result_items(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
        """Normalize legacy lists and current KnowledgeListResponse objects."""
        if value is None:
            return []
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return list(value)
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for key in ('items', 'data', 'knowledge_bases', 'knowledgeBases', 'results'):
                nested = value.get(key)
                if isinstance(nested, (list, tuple)):
                    return list(nested)
                if isinstance(nested, dict):
                    for nested_key in ('items', 'data', 'results'):
                        items = nested.get(nested_key)
                        if isinstance(items, (list, tuple)):
                            return list(items)
            return []
        items = getattr(value, 'items', None)
        return list(items) if isinstance(items, (list, tuple)) else []

    @staticmethod
    async def _call_knowledge_api(method, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Call an Open WebUI model method across minor signature changes."""
        try:
            parameters = inspect.signature(method).parameters
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            parameters = {}
        if parameters and not any(parameter.kind is inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for parameter in parameters.values()):
            kwargs = {key: value for key, value in kwargs.items() if key in parameters}
        result = method(*args, **kwargs)
        return await result if inspect.isawaitable(result) else result

    @classmethod
    async def _knowledge_by_id_with_write_access(cls, knowledges, knowledge_id: str, user_id: str) -> Any:
        """Resolve a writable KB using either the 0.10.x or 0.11.x model API."""
        legacy = getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_by_id_and_user_id', None)
        if callable(legacy):
            return await cls._call_knowledge_api(legacy, knowledge_id, user_id)

        getter = getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_by_id', None)
        if not callable(getter):
            raise RuntimeError('Open WebUI KnowledgeTable neposkytuje kompatibilní načtení znalostní báze.')
        knowledge = await cls._call_knowledge_api(getter, knowledge_id)
        if not knowledge:
            return None
        if str(cls._knowledge_field(knowledge, 'user_id', '') or '') == str(user_id):
            return knowledge

        checker = getattr(knowledges, 'check_access_by_user_id', None)
        if not callable(checker):
            # Without an authoritative access check, fail closed for a KB owned by
            # another user. The Tutor may create its own KB instead of adopting it.
            return None
        allowed = await cls._call_knowledge_api(
            checker,
            knowledge_id,
            user_id,
            permission='write',
        )
        return knowledge if bool(allowed) else None

    @classmethod
    async def _knowledge_bases_with_write_access(cls, knowledges, user_id: str) -> list[Any]:
        """List writable KBs without assuming one Open WebUI minor-version API."""
        legacy = getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_bases_by_user_id', None)
        if callable(legacy):
            result = await cls._call_knowledge_api(legacy, user_id, permission='write')
            return cls._knowledge_result_items(result)

        candidates: list[Any] = []
        searcher = getattr(knowledges, 'search_knowledge_bases', None)
        if callable(searcher):
            access_filter: dict[str, Any] = {'user_id': user_id}
            try:
                from open_webui.models.groups import Groups
                groups = await cls._call_knowledge_api(Groups.get_groups_by_member_id, user_id)
                group_ids = [str(cls._knowledge_field(group, 'id', '') or '') for group in groups or []]
                group_ids = [value for value in group_ids if value]
                if group_ids:
                    access_filter['group_ids'] = group_ids
            except Exception:
                # User grants and ownership remain available even when a particular
                # Open WebUI build changes the optional group helper.
                pass
            result = await cls._call_knowledge_api(
                searcher,
                user_id,
                filter=access_filter,
                skip=0,
                limit=1000,
            )
            candidates = cls._knowledge_result_items(result)
        else:
            getter = getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_bases', None)
            if callable(getter):
                result = await cls._call_knowledge_api(getter, skip=0, limit=1000)
                candidates = cls._knowledge_result_items(result)

        writable: list[Any] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for candidate in candidates:
            knowledge_id = str(cls._knowledge_field(candidate, 'id', '') or '')
            if not knowledge_id or knowledge_id in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(knowledge_id)
            owner_id = str(cls._knowledge_field(candidate, 'user_id', '') or '')
            if owner_id == str(user_id):
                writable.append(candidate)
                continue
            verified = await cls._knowledge_by_id_with_write_access(knowledges, knowledge_id, user_id)
            if verified:
                writable.append(candidate)
        return writable

    def _record_knowledge_api_compat(self, knowledges) -> None:
        legacy = callable(getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_by_id_and_user_id', None))
        modern = callable(getattr(knowledges, 'get_knowledge_by_id', None)) and callable(getattr(knowledges, 'check_access_by_user_id', None))
        self.app.state.STUDY_TUTOR_KNOWLEDGE_API_COMPAT = {
            'version': KNOWLEDGE_API_COMPAT_VERSION,
            'strategy': 'legacy-0.10.x' if legacy else 'modern-0.11.x' if modern else 'unsupported',
            'legacy_lookup': legacy,
            'modern_lookup': modern,
            'list_search': callable(getattr(knowledges, 'search_knowledge_bases', None)),
        }

    async def ensure_knowledge(self, user_id: str) -> str:
        from open_webui.models.knowledge import KnowledgeForm, Knowledges
        self._record_knowledge_api_compat(Knowledges)
        title = 'VUT AI Tutor – moje knihy'
        description = 'Automaticky spravovaná lokální znalostní báze pro VUT AI Tutor. Knihy lze číst v originálním PDF a současně sémanticky vyhledávat. [study-tutor:v1]'

        current = await self.db.get_setting(user_id, 'knowledge_id')
        if current:
            knowledge = await self._knowledge_by_id_with_write_access(Knowledges, current, user_id)
            if knowledge:
                if str(self._knowledge_field(knowledge, 'name', '') or '') != title:
                    updater = getattr(Knowledges, 'update_knowledge_by_id', None)
                    if callable(updater):
                        with suppress(Exception):
                            await self._call_knowledge_api(
                                updater,
                                current,
                                KnowledgeForm(
                                    name=title,
                                    description=description,
                                    access_grants=[_model_dump(value) for value in self._knowledge_field(knowledge, 'access_grants', []) or []],
                                ),
                            )
                return str(current)

        bases = await self._knowledge_bases_with_write_access(Knowledges, user_id)
        for base in bases:
            base_description = str(self._knowledge_field(base, 'description', '') or '')
            base_id = str(self._knowledge_field(base, 'id', '') or '')
            if base_id and '[study-tutor:v1]' in base_description:
                updater = getattr(Knowledges, 'update_knowledge_by_id', None)
                if callable(updater) and str(self._knowledge_field(base, 'name', '') or '') != title:
                    with suppress(Exception):
                        await self._call_knowledge_api(
                            updater,
                            base_id,
                            KnowledgeForm(
                                name=title,
                                description=description,
                                access_grants=[_model_dump(value) for value in self._knowledge_field(base, 'access_grants', []) or []],
                            ),
                        )
                await self.db.set_setting(user_id, 'knowledge_id', base_id)
                return base_id

        creator = getattr(Knowledges, 'insert_new_knowledge', None)
        if not callable(creator):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail='Open WebUI neposkytuje kompatibilní vytvoření znalostní báze.')
        created = await self._call_knowledge_api(
            creator,
            user_id,
            KnowledgeForm(name=title, description=description, access_grants=[]),
        )
        created_id = str(self._knowledge_field(created, 'id', '') or '')
        if not created_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail='Nepodařilo se vytvořit znalostní bázi VUT AI Tutor.')
        await self.db.set_setting(user_id, 'knowledge_id', created_id)
        return created_id

    @staticmethod
    def _hash_pdf_path(path: Path) -> str:
        """Hash actual PDF bytes, without extraction, re-encoding or normalization."""
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open('rb') as handle:
            first = handle.read(1024)
            if b'%PDF-' not in first:
                raise ValueError('not_pdf')
            digest.update(first)
            for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                digest.update(block)
        return digest.hexdigest()

    async def _raw_file_sha256(self, file_item) -> str:
        """Keep raw bytes separate from Open WebUI File.hash (extracted text).

        File.meta.file_hash is a raw-byte reference for unavailable originals, not
        sufficient proof that a different accessible file contains those bytes.
        Accessible records are hashed, with a bounded stat-keyed in-memory cache.
        """
        meta = _model_dump(getattr(file_item, 'meta', None))
        reference = _sha256_digest(meta.get('file_hash'))
        try:
            path = await self._resolve_record_path(file_item)
            st = await asyncio.to_thread(path.stat)
            key = (str(getattr(file_item, 'user_id', '')), str(getattr(file_item, 'id', '')),
                   str(path.resolve()), st.st_size, st.st_mtime_ns, st.st_ctime_ns, st.st_ino)
            if key in self._pdf_hash_cache:
                return self._pdf_hash_cache[key]
            digest = await asyncio.to_thread(self._hash_pdf_path, path)
            if len(self._pdf_hash_cache) >= 256:
                self._pdf_hash_cache.pop(next(iter(self._pdf_hash_cache)))
            self._pdf_hash_cache[key] = digest
            return digest
        except ValueError:
            return ''
        except (HTTPException, OSError):
            return reference

    async def _register_pdf_book(self, user_id: str, knowledge_id: str, file_id: str, title: str) -> dict:
        from open_webui.models.files import Files
        item = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, file_id)
        if not item or getattr(item, 'user_id', None) != user_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Zdrojový soubor knihy nebyl nalezen.')
        digest = await self._raw_file_sha256(item)
        if digest:
            # Verify prospective matches before register_book chooses a canonical
            # record. A legacy text hash must not trap a fresh upload in an old,
            # unverifiable source when no library-state request ran beforehand.
            matches = await self.db.all('SELECT file_id FROM books WHERE user_id=? AND file_sha256=?', (user_id, digest))
            for row in matches:
                candidate = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, row['file_id'])
                actual = ''
                if candidate and getattr(candidate, 'user_id', None) == user_id:
                    actual = await self._raw_file_sha256(candidate)
                if actual != digest:
                    await self.db.update_book_file_hash(user_id, row['file_id'], actual)
        return await self.db.register_book(user_id, knowledge_id, file_id, title, digest)

    async def _resume_registered_book_index(self, request: Request, user, book: dict) -> None:
        """A duplicate upload may restore bytes; deduplicated does not mean indexed."""
        from open_webui.models.knowledge import Knowledges
        file_id = str(book['file_id'])
        if not book.get('deduplicated'):
            self.schedule_safe_index(request, user, book)
            return
        state = await self.file_processing_state(file_id)
        linked = await self._call_knowledge_api(Knowledges.has_file, book['knowledge_id'], file_id)
        if state.get('text_status') != 'completed' or state.get('semantic_index_status') != 'completed' or not linked:
            # An explicit upload/attachment is allowed to retry before the cooldown.
            self.schedule_safe_index(request, user, book, force=True)

    async def consolidate_user_library(self, user_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        """Populate missing hashes and hide byte-identical historical duplicates."""
        from open_webui.models.files import Files
        rows = await self.db.list_all_books(user_id)
        enriched: list[dict] = []
        for row in rows:
            file_item = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, row['file_id'])
            digest = ''
            if file_item and getattr(file_item, 'user_id', None) == user_id:
                digest = await self._raw_file_sha256(file_item)
            # Older versions sometimes put the extracted-text hash into this field.
            # Do not let that unverified value identify a PDF or merge more books.
            if digest != str(row.get('file_sha256') or ''):
                await self.db.update_book_file_hash(user_id, row['file_id'], digest)
                row['file_sha256'] = digest
            enriched.append(row)
        groups: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
        for row in enriched:
            digest = str(row.get('file_sha256') or '')
            if digest and (not row.get('canonical_file_id')):
                groups[digest].append(row)
        for digest, group in groups.items():
            if len(group) < 2:
                continue
            scored = []
            for row in group:
                analysis = await self.db.get_analysis(user_id, row['file_id'])
                path = await self.db.get_learning_path(user_id, row['file_id'])
                score = (100 if analysis and analysis.get('deep_status') == 'completed' else 0, 50 if analysis and analysis.get('status') == 'completed' else 0, 20 if path else 0, int(row.get('updated_at') or 0))
                scored.append((score, row))
            scored.sort(key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
            canonical = scored[0][1]
            duplicates = [item[1]['file_id'] for item in scored[1:]]
            await self.db.mark_duplicate_books(user_id, canonical['file_id'], duplicates)
        return await self.db.list_books(user_id)

    async def _resolve_record_path(self, file_item) -> Path:
        """Resolve an already authorized record. Never search by title or change DB paths."""
        from open_webui.storage.provider import Storage
        file_id = str(getattr(file_item, 'id', '') or '')
        path_value = getattr(file_item, 'path', None)

        def fail(status: int, code: str, message: str):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status, detail={
                'code': code, 'message': message, 'file_id': file_id,
            })

        if path_value is not None and not isinstance(path_value, (str, os.PathLike)):
            fail(409, 'file_path_invalid', 'Záznam souboru obsahuje neplatnou cestu do úložiště.')
        raw = os.fspath(path_value) if path_value is not None else ''
        if not isinstance(raw, str) or '\x00' in raw:
            fail(409, 'file_path_invalid', 'Záznam souboru obsahuje neplatnou cestu do úložiště.')

        local_storage = type(Storage).__name__ == 'LocalStorageProvider'
        upload_dir = None
        try:
            from open_webui.config import STORAGE_PROVIDER, UPLOAD_DIR
            local_storage = str(STORAGE_PROVIDER).strip().lower() == 'local'
            upload_dir = Path(str(UPLOAD_DIR))
        except (ImportError, AttributeError):
            # No guessed global directories or other users' uploads.
            pass

        resolved = None
        if raw.strip():
            try:
                resolved = await _call_file_api(Storage.get_file, raw)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            except PermissionError as exc:
                log.warning('Tutor storage permission failure file_id=%s', file_id, exc_info=True)
                fail(503, 'storage_permission_denied', 'Proces Open WebUI nemá přístup k uloženému souboru.')
            except Exception as exc:
                error_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
                log.exception('Tutor storage failure error_id=%s file_id=%s', error_id, file_id)
                raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={
                    'code': 'storage_provider_error', 'message': 'Úložiště Open WebUI nedokázalo načíst soubor.',
                    'file_id': file_id, 'error_id': error_id, 'error_type': type(exc).__name__,
                }) from exc
        if resolved is not None:
            if not isinstance(resolved, (str, os.PathLike)):
                fail(502, 'storage_path_invalid', 'Úložiště nevrátilo platnou cestu k souboru.')
            try:
                resolved_text = os.fspath(resolved)
                if not isinstance(resolved_text, str) or '\x00' in resolved_text:
                    fail(502, 'storage_path_invalid', 'Úložiště nevrátilo platnou cestu k souboru.')
                if resolved_text.strip():
                    candidate = Path(resolved_text)
                    if await asyncio.to_thread(candidate.is_file):
                        return candidate
            except PermissionError:
                fail(503, 'storage_permission_denied', 'Proces Open WebUI nemá přístup k uloženému souboru.')
            except OSError:
                fail(503, 'storage_io_error', 'Soubor nelze přečíst kvůli chybě úložiště.')

        # Recover a moved/missing local path only by the exact persisted UUID.
        # S3/GCS/Azure and title-based matches are deliberately excluded.
        valid_uuid = re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-fA-F]{8}(?:-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}', file_id)
        if local_storage and upload_dir is not None and valid_uuid:
            def find_owned_upload():
                root = upload_dir.resolve()
                if not root.is_dir():
                    return []
                found = set()
                for entry in root.glob(file_id + '*'):
                    suffix = entry.name[len(file_id):]
                    if suffix and suffix[0] not in '-_.':
                        continue
                    target = entry.resolve()
                    if target.is_relative_to(root) and target.is_file():
                        found.add(target)
                return sorted(found)
            try:
                candidates = await asyncio.to_thread(find_owned_upload)
            except PermissionError:
                fail(503, 'storage_permission_denied', 'Proces Open WebUI nemá přístup do adresáře uploads.')
            except OSError:
                fail(503, 'storage_io_error', 'Adresář uploads nelze přečíst kvůli chybě úložiště.')
            if len(candidates) == 1:
                log.info('Tutor resolved local upload by exact file UUID file_id=%s; database unchanged', file_id)
                return candidates[0]
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                fail(409, 'file_path_ambiguous', 'V uploads je více souborů se stejným ID; automatický výběr byl odmítnut.')
        if not raw.strip():
            fail(409, 'file_path_missing', 'Záznam knihy nemá cestu k originálnímu souboru a originál nebyl jednoznačně nalezen v uploads.')
        fail(404, 'file_not_found', 'Originální soubor nebyl nalezen v úložišti. Zkontrolujte datový adresář Desktopu nebo znovu nahrajte původní PDF.')

    async def _resolve_file_path(self, file_item) -> Path:
        """Resolve a book's bytes without changing its stable study identity.

        First use the original authorized record (including exact UUID recovery).
        Only a missing source may fall back to an owned byte-identical upload.
        Permission/provider/ambiguous-path errors are not bypassed. A filename,
        extracted-text hash, or historical canonical link is never byte proof.
        """
        try:
            return await self._resolve_record_path(file_item)
        except HTTPException as exc:
            detail = exc.detail if isinstance(exc.detail, dict) else {}
            if detail.get('code') not in {'file_path_missing', 'file_not_found'}:
                raise
            original_error = exc
        user_id = str(getattr(file_item, 'user_id', '') or '')
        file_id = str(getattr(file_item, 'id', '') or '')
        meta = _model_dump(getattr(file_item, 'meta', None))
        expected = _sha256_digest(meta.get('file_hash'))
        if not user_id or not file_id or not expected:
            # Without the original raw-byte reference, do not guess from File.hash
            # or from books.file_sha256 populated by affected historical versions.
            original_error.detail = {**original_error.detail,
                'recovery': 'original_raw_hash_missing',
                'hint': 'Chybí ověřitelná identita originálu. Nahrajte PDF jako novou knihu; původní záznam nemažte.'}
            raise original_error
        from open_webui.models.files import Files
        candidates: set[str] = set()
        rows = await self.db.all('SELECT file_id FROM books WHERE user_id=? AND file_sha256=?', (user_id, expected))
        candidates.update(str(row['file_id']) for row in rows)
        # A new copy may have been uploaded in the chat before Tutor registered it.
        get_owned = getattr(Files, 'get_files_by_user_id', None)
        if callable(get_owned):
            try:
                for item in await _call_file_api(get_owned, user_id) or []:
                    if getattr(item, 'user_id', None) != user_id:
                        continue
                    item_meta = _model_dump(getattr(item, 'meta', None))
                    if _sha256_digest(item_meta.get('file_hash')) == expected:
                        candidates.add(str(getattr(item, 'id', '') or ''))
            except Exception:
                log.debug('Tutor owned-copy lookup unavailable; checking registered copies only')
        candidates.discard(file_id)
        candidates.discard('')
        for source_id in sorted(candidates):
            item = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, source_id)
            if not item or getattr(item, 'user_id', None) != user_id:
                continue
            item_meta = _model_dump(getattr(item, 'meta', None))
            claimed = _sha256_digest(item_meta.get('file_hash'))
            if claimed and claimed != expected:
                continue
            try:
                path = await self._resolve_record_path(item)  # no recursive fallback
                actual = await asyncio.to_thread(self._hash_pdf_path, path)
            except (HTTPException, OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            if not hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected):
                continue
            log.info('Tutor PDF source recovered by verified raw SHA-256 book_id=%s source_id=%s; study identity and Open WebUI paths unchanged', file_id, source_id)
            return path
        original_error.detail = {**original_error.detail,
            'recovery': 'no_verified_owned_copy',
            'hint': 'Nahrajte znovu stejný původní PDF soubor do VUT AI Tutora. Existující knihu ani studijní historii nemažte.'}
        raise original_error

    async def _get_file(self, user_id: str, file_id: str):
        from open_webui.models.files import Files
        book = await self.db.get_book(user_id, file_id)
        if not book:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Kniha nebyla nalezena ve vaší studijní knihovně.')
        canonical_file_id = str(book.get('file_id') or file_id)
        file_item = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, canonical_file_id)
        if not file_item or getattr(file_item, 'user_id', None) != user_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Zdrojový soubor knihy nebyl nalezen.')
        return (file_item, book)

    async def file_processing_state(self, file_id: str) -> dict:
        """Return independent text-extraction and semantic-index states.

        Open WebUI's file ``status`` is kept at ``completed`` once safe page text exists,
        even when an embedding provider is unavailable. This lets the reader, TOC and
        concept map continue to work while semantic search is reported separately.
        """
        from open_webui.models.files import Files
        file_item = await _call_file_api(Files.get_file_by_id, file_id)
        if not file_item:
            return {'status': 'missing', 'error': 'Soubor již neexistuje.', 'text_status': 'missing', 'semantic_index_status': 'missing', 'semantic_index_error': 'Soubor již neexistuje.'}
        data = _model_dump(getattr(file_item, 'data', None))
        content = str(data.get('content') or '')
        status = str(data.get('status') or ('completed' if content else 'processing'))
        text_status = str(data.get('study_text_status') or ('completed' if content else status))
        semantic_marker = str(data.get('study_index_status') or '').strip()
        if semantic_marker:
            semantic_status = semantic_marker
        elif content:
            semantic_status = 'pending'
        else:
            semantic_status = status
        semantic_error = data.get('study_index_error')
        duplicate_reused = bool(data.get('study_index_reused')) or self._is_duplicate_content_error(semantic_error)
        if duplicate_reused:
            semantic_status = 'completed'
            semantic_error = None
            if data.get('study_index_status') != 'completed' or data.get('study_index_error'):
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await Files.update_file_data_by_id(file_id, {**data, 'study_index_status': 'completed', 'study_index_error': None, 'study_index_reused': True})
        return {'status': status, 'error': data.get('error'), 'text_status': text_status, 'text_error': data.get('study_text_error'), 'semantic_index_status': semantic_status, 'semantic_index_error': semantic_error, 'semantic_index_reused': duplicate_reused, 'text_chars': len(content)}

    async def file_status(self, file_id: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
        state = await self.file_processing_state(file_id)
        return (state['status'], state.get('error'))

    async def list_models(self, request: Request, user) -> list[dict]:
        try:
            from open_webui.utils.models import get_all_models, get_filtered_models
            models = await get_all_models(request, refresh=False, user=user)
            models = await get_filtered_models(models, user)
        except Exception:
            models = list(getattr(request.app.state, 'MODELS', {}).values())
        result = []
        blocked_ids = {PIPE_FUNCTION_ID, 'study-tutor', 'study_tutor'}
        for model in models or []:
            model_id = str(model.get('id') or '')
            if not model_id or model_id in blocked_ids:
                continue
            if model.get('pipe') or model.get('arena'):
                continue
            info = model.get('info') or {}
            if hasattr(info, 'model_dump'):
                info = info.model_dump()
            info = info if isinstance(info, dict) else {}
            meta = info.get('meta') or model.get('meta') or {}
            if hasattr(meta, 'model_dump'):
                meta = meta.model_dump()
            meta = meta if isinstance(meta, dict) else {}
            capabilities = meta.get('capabilities') or info.get('capabilities') or model.get('capabilities') or {}
            if hasattr(capabilities, 'model_dump'):
                capabilities = capabilities.model_dump()
            capabilities = capabilities if isinstance(capabilities, dict) else {}
            name = str(model.get('name') or model_id)
            name_key = f'{model_id} {name}'.casefold()
            vision = bool(capabilities.get('vision')) or any((token in name_key for token in ('vision', 'gpt-4o', 'gemini', 'pixtral', 'qwen-vl', 'qwen2-vl', 'llava', 'internvl')))
            result.append({'id': model_id, 'name': name, 'vision': vision})
        result.sort(key=lambda item: item['name'].casefold())
        return result

    async def model_supports_vision(self, request: Request, user, model_id: str) -> bool:
        return any((item.get('id') == model_id and item.get('vision') for item in await self.list_models(request, user)))

    async def choose_base_model(self, request: Request, user, preferred: str='') -> str:
        models = await self.list_models(request, user)
        if not models:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='VUT AI Tutor nenašel žádný základní jazykový model. V Open WebUI Desktop nejprve zapněte lokální model nebo připojte poskytovatele.')
        saved = str(await self.db.get_setting(user.id, 'base_model_id') or '')
        user_selected = str(await self.db.get_setting(user.id, 'base_model_user_selected', '0') or '0') == '1'

        def compact(value: str) -> str:
            return re.sub('[^a-z0-9]+', '', str(value or '').casefold())

        def resolve(candidate: str) -> str:
            candidate = str(candidate or '').strip()
            if not candidate:
                return ''
            folded = candidate.casefold()
            candidate_compact = compact(candidate)
            matches = []
            for item in models:
                model_id = str(item.get('id') or '')
                name = str(item.get('name') or model_id)
                model_folded = model_id.casefold()
                name_folded = name.casefold()
                combined = f'{model_id} {name}'.casefold()
                combined_compact = compact(combined)
                if model_folded == folded:
                    score = 0
                elif name_folded == folded:
                    score = 1
                elif re.search(f'(?:^|[/.:_-]){re.escape(folded)}(?:$|[:/_-])', model_folded):
                    score = 2
                elif candidate_compact and combined_compact.endswith(candidate_compact):
                    score = 3
                elif candidate_compact and candidate_compact in combined_compact:
                    score = 8 + max(0, len(combined_compact) - len(candidate_compact)) / 1000
                else:
                    continue
                if 'safeguard' in combined and 'safeguard' not in folded:
                    score += 100
                matches.append((score, len(model_id), model_id))
            return min(matches)[2] if matches else ''
        ordered = []
        if user_selected:
            ordered.append(saved)
        ordered.extend([DEFAULT_BASE_MODEL_ID, preferred if preferred and preferred != DEFAULT_BASE_MODEL_ID else '', saved if not user_selected else ''])
        for candidate in ordered:
            resolved = resolve(candidate)
            if resolved:
                return resolved

        def rank(item: dict) -> tuple:
            name = f"{item['id']} {item['name']}".casefold()
            penalty = sum((100 for term in ('embed', 'rerank', 'whisper', 'tts', 'vision-only', 'safeguard') if term in name))
            bonus = 0
            for term, weight in (('glm-5', -8), ('glm5', -8), ('glm', -5), ('reason', -3), ('math', -2), ('instruct', -1), ('chat', -1), ('gpt-oss', -1), ('qwen', -1), ('llama', -1), ('gemma', -1), ('mistral', -1)):
                if term in name:
                    bonus += weight
            return (penalty + bonus, item['name'].casefold())
        return sorted(models, key=rank)[0]['id']

    async def get_active_book(self, user_id: str, session_id: str | None=None) -> dict | None:
        if session_id:
            session = await self.db.get_session(user_id, session_id)
            session_file_id = str((session or {}).get('file_id') or '')
            if session_file_id:
                book = await self.db.get_book(user_id, session_file_id)
                if book:
                    return book
        active = await self.db.get_setting(user_id, 'active_file_id')
        books = await self.consolidate_user_library(user_id)
        if active:
            for book in books:
                if book['file_id'] == active:
                    return book
        if books:
            await self.db.set_setting(user_id, 'active_file_id', books[0]['file_id'])
            return books[0]
        return None

    def _analysis_task_running(self, user_id: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
        task = self._analysis_tasks.get(f'{user_id}:{file_id}')
        return bool(task and (not task.done()))

    def _analysis_needs_resume(self, user_id: str, file_id: str, row: dict | None) -> bool:
        if not row or row.get('status') != 'processing':
            return False
        if self._analysis_task_running(user_id, file_id):
            return False
        return _now() - int(row.get('updated_at') or 0) >= 45

    async def refresh_session_tool_catalog(self, request: Request, user, session_id: str, *, force: bool=False) -> dict:
        """Re-scan the user's server-side workspace without requiring a new chat message.

        Client-only direct tools can only be learned from the next turn because their callable
        bridge lives in the browser. Workspace Tools, OpenAPI/MCP connections, Terminal servers,
        builtins, Functions and Skills are refreshed here immediately.
        """
        lock = self._tool_discovery_locks.setdefault(session_id, asyncio.Lock())
        async with lock:
            state = await self.db.get_session_tool_state(user.id, session_id)
            context = state.get('context') or {}
            model_meta = _model_dump(context.get('model_meta') or {})
            model_id = str(context.get('model_id') or '')
            model_payload = {'id': model_id, 'info': {'meta': model_meta}}
            metadata = {'chat_id': str(context.get('chat_id') or ''), 'session_id': session_id, 'tool_ids': context.get('tool_ids') or [], 'skill_ids': context.get('skill_ids') or [], 'features': context.get('features') or {}}
            body = {'model': model_id, 'messages': [], 'tool_ids': context.get('tool_ids') or [], 'skill_ids': context.get('skill_ids') or [], 'features': context.get('features') or {}, 'metadata': metadata}
            resolved = await self._resolve_available_tools(request, user, {}, body=body, metadata=metadata, model_payload=model_payload, files=[], force_refresh=force, skill_ids=context.get('skill_ids') or [])
            catalog = self._safe_tool_catalog(resolved)
            inventory = self._full_tool_inventory(resolved)
            summary = self._tool_source_summary(inventory)
            active_keys = [str(item.get('registry_key') or '') for item in inventory if item.get('active_in_chat')]
            previous_inventory = state.get('inventory') or []
            previous_catalog = state.get('catalog') or []
            known_inventory_keys = {str(item.get('registry_key') or '') for item in inventory}
            for item in previous_inventory:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                if str(item.get('source_kind') or '').startswith('direct-') and str(item.get('registry_key') or '') not in known_inventory_keys:
                    stale = dict(item)
                    stale['active_in_chat'] = False
                    stale['availability'] = 'awaiting-next-turn'
                    inventory.append(stale)
            known_catalog = {(str(item.get('tool_id') or ''), str(item.get('function_name') or '')) for item in catalog}
            for item in previous_catalog:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                key = (str(item.get('tool_id') or ''), str(item.get('function_name') or ''))
                if str(item.get('source_kind') or '').startswith('direct-') and key not in known_catalog:
                    stale = dict(item)
                    stale['active_in_chat'] = False
                    stale['availability'] = 'awaiting-next-turn'
                    catalog.append(stale)
            summary = self._tool_source_summary(inventory)
            update = await self.db.set_session_tools(user.id, session_id, catalog, inventory=inventory, source_summary=summary, active_keys=active_keys, context=context)
            return {**await self.db.get_session_tool_state(user.id, session_id), 'changed': update.get('changed', False)}

    async def state_payload(self, request: Request, claims: dict) -> dict:
        user = await self.user_from_claims(claims)
        books = await self.consolidate_user_library(user.id)
        enriched = []
        for book in books:
            processing = await self.file_processing_state(book['file_id'])
            learning_path = await self.db.get_learning_path(user.id, book['file_id'])
            enriched.append({**book, **processing, 'learning_path': self.learning_path_summary(learning_path)})
            if processing['status'] == 'failed' or processing['semantic_index_status'] in {'failed', 'missing', 'pending', 'processing'}:
                self.schedule_safe_index(request, user, book)
        active = await self.get_active_book(user.id, claims.get('sid'))
        active_payload = None
        if active:
            processing = await self.file_processing_state(active['file_id'])
            analysis = await self.db.get_analysis(user.id, active['file_id'])
            learning_path = await self.db.get_learning_path(user.id, active['file_id'])

    @staticmethod
    def _download_demo_pdf() -> tuple[Path, int]:
        """Download the fixed official demo PDF to a private temporary file."""
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(DEMO_BOOK_URL)
        if parsed.scheme != 'https' or parsed.hostname != 'venhance.github.io':
            raise ValueError('Neplatný zdroj ukázkové knihy.')
        fd, raw_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='study-tutor-demo-', suffix='.pdf')
        path = Path(raw_path)
        total = 0
        try:
            request = urllib.request.Request(DEMO_BOOK_URL, headers={'User-Agent': f'VUT-AI-Tutor/{PLUGIN_VERSION}', 'Accept': 'application/pdf'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=90) as response, os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as output:
                final = urllib.parse.urlparse(response.geturl())
                if final.scheme != 'https' or final.hostname != 'venhance.github.io':
                    raise ValueError('Zdroj ukázkové knihy přesměroval na nepovolenou doménu.')
                length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                if length and int(length) > MAX_DEMO_BOOK_BYTES:
                    raise ValueError('Ukázková kniha překračuje bezpečnostní limit velikosti.')
                while True:
                    chunk = response.read(1024 * 1024)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    total += len(chunk)
                    if total > MAX_DEMO_BOOK_BYTES:
                        raise ValueError('Ukázková kniha překračuje bezpečnostní limit velikosti.')
                    output.write(chunk)
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
            with path.open('rb') as check:
                signature = check.read(5)
            if total < 1024 or signature != b'%PDF-':
                raise ValueError('Zdroj nevrátil platný PDF dokument.')
            return (path, total)
        except Exception:
            with suppress(Exception):
                os.close(fd)
            with suppress(Exception):
                path.unlink()
            raise

    @staticmethod
    def _is_spa_catchall_route(route: Any) -> bool:
        """Identify the root frontend route that would swallow dynamically added endpoints."""
        path = str(getattr(route, 'path', '') or '')
        if route.__class__.__name__ == 'Mount' and path in {'', '/'}:
            return True
        return path.rstrip('/') in {'/{path:path}', '/{full_path:path}'}

    @staticmethod

    def _study_route_diagnostics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Inspect only the isolated Tutor router and the outer ASGI gateway."""
        route_router = getattr(self, 'route_router', None)
        routes = list(getattr(route_router, 'routes', None) or [])
        owned = [route for route in routes if self._route_is_study_path(route)]
        method_path_counts: Counter = Counter()
        methods_by_path: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
        for route in owned:
            path = str(getattr(route, 'path', '') or '')
            methods = {str(value).upper() for value in (getattr(route, 'methods', None) or set())}
            if not methods:
                methods = {'MOUNT'}
            methods_by_path[path].update(methods)
            for method in methods:
                method_path_counts[(method, path)] += 1
        missing_required: list[str] = []
        for path, required_methods in REQUIRED_STUDY_ROUTE_METHODS.items():
            available = methods_by_path.get(path, set())
            for method in sorted(required_methods):
                if method not in available:
                    missing_required.append(f'{method} {path}')
        duplicate_method_paths = [
            f'{method} {path} ({count}x)'
            for (method, path), count in sorted(method_path_counts.items())
            if count > 1
        ]
        registered_runtime_id = str(getattr(self.app.state, 'STUDY_TUTOR_ROUTES_RUNTIME_ID', '') or '')
        bound_to_current_runtime = registered_runtime_id == self.runtime_id and all(
            str(getattr(route, '_vut_ai_tutor_runtime_id', '') or '') == self.runtime_id
            for route in owned
        )
        gateway = getattr(self.app.state, 'STUDY_TUTOR_ASGI_GATEWAY', {})
        gateway_active = bool(isinstance(gateway, dict) and gateway.get('active'))
        required_complete = not missing_required
        healthy = gateway_active and required_complete and not duplicate_method_paths and bound_to_current_runtime
        diagnostics: dict[str, Any] = {
            'registration_version': ROUTE_REGISTRATION_VERSION,
            'registration_strategy': 'asgi-prefix-gateway-v7',
            'runtime_id': self.runtime_id,
            'registered_runtime_id': registered_runtime_id,
            'bound_to_current_runtime': bound_to_current_runtime,
            'study_routes': len(owned),
            'nested_legacy_route_nodes': 0,
            'inserted_at': 0 if gateway_active else -1,
            'spa_at': -1,
            'before_spa': gateway_active,
            'required_complete': required_complete,
            'missing_required': missing_required,
            'duplicate_method_paths': duplicate_method_paths,
            'router_cache_invalidation_supported': False,
            'main_router_style': 'unmodified',
            'main_router_mutated': False,
            'gateway_active': gateway_active,
            'healthy': healthy,
        }
        setattr(self.app.state, 'STUDY_TUTOR_ROUTE_DIAGNOSTICS', diagnostics)
        return diagnostics

    def _remove_study_routes(self) -> int:
        """Detach only the isolated route app; never mutate Open WebUI's router."""
        previous = len(list(getattr(getattr(self, 'route_app', None), 'routes', None) or []))
        self.route_app = None
        self.route_router = None
        self.app.state.STUDY_TUTOR_ROUTE_APP = None

        return previous

    def _promote_study_routes_before_spa(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

        return self._study_route_diagnostics()

    async def _save_selection_crop(self, user_id: str, selection_id: str, data_url: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        value = str(data_url or '').strip()
        if not value:
            return ('', '')
        match = re.fullmatch('data:(image/(?:png|webp|jpeg));base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=\\r\\n]+)', value, re.I)
        if not match:
            return ('', '')
        mime = match.group(1).lower()
        try:
            raw = base64.b64decode(re.sub('\\s+', '', match.group(2)), validate=True)
        except Exception:
            return ('', '')
        if not raw or len(raw) > MAX_SELECTION_IMAGE_BYTES:
            return ('', '')
        extension = {'image/png': 'png', 'image/webp': 'webp', 'image/jpeg': 'jpg'}[mime]
        owner_key = hashlib.sha256(user_id.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:20]
        directory = self.root / 'selection_crops' / owner_key
        await asyncio.to_thread(directory.mkdir, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = directory / f'{selection_id}.{extension}'
        await asyncio.to_thread(path.write_bytes, raw)
        return (str(path.relative_to(self.root)), mime)

    async def _selection_crop_data_url(self, selection: dict | None) -> str:
        relative = str((selection or {}).get('crop_path') or '')
        mime = str((selection or {}).get('crop_mime') or '')
        if not relative or mime not in {'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpeg'}:
            return ''
        try:
            path = (self.root / relative).resolve()
            root = self.root.resolve()
            if root not in path.parents or not path.is_file():
                return ''
            raw = await asyncio.to_thread(path.read_bytes)
            if not raw or len(raw) > MAX_SELECTION_IMAGE_BYTES:
                return ''
            return f"data:{mime};base64,{base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')}"
        except Exception:
            return ''

            @router.api_route('/api/pdf/{file_id}', methods=['GET', 'HEAD'])
            async def get_pdf(request: Request, file_id: str):
                claims = await self.claims_from_request(request)
                file_item, _ = await self._get_file(claims['uid'], file_id)
                file_path = await self._resolve_file_path(file_item)
                handle = None
                try:
                    # Open and inspect before sending headers, not later inside FileResponse.
                    def open_pdf():
                        stream = file_path.open('rb')
                        try:
                            size = os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_size
                            signature = stream.read(1024)
                            stream.seek(0)
                            return stream, size, signature
                        except BaseException:
                            stream.close()
                            raise
                    handle, size, signature = await asyncio.to_thread(open_pdf)
                    if not size or b'%PDF-' not in signature:
                        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail={
                            'code': 'pdf_invalid_header', 'message': 'Uložený soubor je prázdný nebo nemá hlavičku PDF.', 'file_id': file_id,
                        })
                    title = str(getattr(file_item, 'filename', '') or 'book.pdf')
                    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(title, safe='')
                    common_headers = {
                        **_cors_headers(), 'Content-Disposition': f"inline; filename*=UTF-8''{encoded}",
                        'Cache-Control': 'private, no-store', 'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
                        'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'X-Study-Tutor-Version': PLUGIN_VERSION,
                        'X-Study-Tutor-PDF-Delivery': 'pdf-delivery-r2',
                    }
                    start, end, status = 0, size - 1, 200
                    # Range applies to GET, not HEAD.
                    range_header = request.headers.get('range', '').strip() if request.method == 'GET' else ''
                    if range_header:
                        match = re.fullmatch(r'bytes=([0-9]*)-([0-9]*)', range_header)
                        invalid = not match or not any(match.groups())
                        if not invalid:
                            first, last = match.groups()
                            # Oversized integers must not turn malformed Range into HTTP 500.
                            if len(first) > 20 or len(last) > 20:
                                invalid = True
                            elif first:
                                start = int(first)
                                end = int(last) if last else size - 1
                                invalid = start >= size or end < start
                            else:
                                suffix = int(last)
                                invalid = suffix <= 0
                                start = max(0, size - suffix)
                            end = min(end, size - 1)
                        if invalid:
                            return Response(status_code=416, headers={**common_headers, 'Content-Range': f'bytes */{size}'})
                        status = 206
                    length = end - start + 1
                    response_headers = {**common_headers, 'Content-Length': str(length)}
                    if status == 206:
                        response_headers['Content-Range'] = f'bytes {start}-{end}/{size}'
                    if request.method == 'HEAD':
                        return Response(status_code=200, media_type='application/pdf', headers=response_headers)
                    await asyncio.to_thread(handle.seek, start)
                    response = PdfStreamResponse(handle, length, status_code=status, headers=response_headers)
                    handle = None  # Response owns and closes it, including on disconnect.
                    return response
                except FileNotFoundError as exc:
                    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail={'code': 'file_not_found', 'message': 'Originální PDF již není v úložišti.', 'file_id': file_id}) from exc
                except PermissionError as exc:
                    raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail={'code': 'storage_permission_denied', 'message': 'Proces Open WebUI nemá oprávnění číst PDF.', 'file_id': file_id}) from exc
                except OSError as exc:
                    error_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
                    log.exception('Tutor PDF I/O failure error_id=%s file_id=%s', error_id, file_id)
                    raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail={'code': 'storage_io_error', 'message': 'PDF nelze přečíst kvůli chybě úložiště.', 'file_id': file_id, 'error_id': error_id}) from exc
                finally:
                    if handle is not None:
                        handle.close()

            @router.post('/api/selections')
            async def create_selection(request: Request, form: SelectionForm):
                claims = await self.claims_from_request(request)
                active = await self.get_active_book(claims['uid'], claims.get('sid'))
                if not active:
                    raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Nejprve přidejte nebo otevřete knihu.')
                text = _normalize_selection_text(form.text)
                if len(text) < 2:
                    raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Výběr je příliš krátký.')
                linear_text = _normalize_spatial_selection_text(form.linear_text or text)
                latex_text = _normalize_spatial_selection_text(form.latex_text, MAX_SELECTION_LATEX_CHARS)
                latex_confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(form.latex_confidence or 0)))
                mathml_text = _normalize_spatial_selection_text(form.mathml_text, MAX_SELECTION_LATEX_CHARS)
                context_before = _normalize_selection_text(form.context_before, 4000)
                context_after = _normalize_selection_text(form.context_after, 4000)
                quality = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9+_.:-]', '', str(form.transcription_quality or 'plain-text'))[:120] or 'plain-text'
                rectangles = []
                for raw in form.rectangles[:120]:
                    try:
                        rect = {key: float(raw.get(key, 0)) for key in ('x', 'y', 'width', 'height')}
                    except Exception:
                        continue
                    if all((math.isfinite(v) for v in rect.values())) and rect['width'] > 0 and (rect['height'] > 0):
                        rectangles.append({key: max(0.0, min(1.0, value)) for key, value in rect.items()})
                glyphs = []
                for raw in form.glyphs[:MAX_SELECTION_GLYPHS]:
                    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
                        continue
                    item = {'text': _normalize_selection_text(raw.get('text'), 500)}
                    for key in ('x', 'y', 'width', 'height', 'font_size'):
                        try:
                            value = float(raw.get(key, 0))
                        except Exception:
                            value = 0.0
                        if not math.isfinite(value):
                            value = 0.0
                        item[key] = max(0.0, min(10000.0 if key == 'font_size' else 1.0, value))
                    item['font_name'] = str(raw.get('font_name') or '')[:200]
                    item['direction'] = str(raw.get('direction') or 'ltr')[:12]
                    try:
                        item['item_index'] = int(raw.get('item_index', -1))
                    except Exception:
                        item['item_index'] = -1
                    if item['text']:
                        glyphs.append(item)
                selection_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                crop_path, crop_mime = await self._save_selection_crop(claims['uid'], selection_id, form.image_data_url)
                row = await self.db.add_selection(claims['uid'], claims['sid'], active['file_id'], form.page_index, text, rectangles, linear_text=linear_text, latex_text=latex_text, latex_confidence=latex_confidence, mathml_text=mathml_text, context_before=context_before, context_after=context_after, glyphs=glyphs, crop_path=crop_path, crop_mime=crop_mime, transcription_quality=quality, selection_id=selection_id)
                row['has_visual_crop'] = bool(crop_path)
                row.pop('crop_path', None)
                return self._response_json(row, 201)
